### [230] [Provable Benefits of RLVR over SFT for Reasoning Models: Learning to Backtrack Efficiently](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22938)
*Stanley Wei,Juno Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过将CoT推理建模为图上的路径发现问题，从理论上证明了强化学习（RLVR）相比监督微调（SFT）在推理能力上的优势：SFT因缺乏负样本无法学会高效回溯，而RLVR可以使用结果奖励学会从死胡同高效回溯，导致两者在推理时计算复杂度上存在指数级差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解为什么强化学习微调（RLVR）相比监督微调（SFT）能诱导出更强的推理能力，从理论层面解释两者之间的根本差异。

Method: 将链式推理（CoT）建模为图上的路径发现问题，从理论上对比分析RLVR与SFT的学习机制差异，证明SFT因缺乏负样本无法学习高效回溯，而RLVR可通过结果奖励学会回溯。

Result: 证明了SFT在仅使用黄金最短路径（无负样本）训练时无法学会高效回溯；RLVR模型则能利用结果奖励学会从死胡同高效回溯，导致两者在推理时计算复杂度上存在指数级分离；RLVR模型学会识别推理链中的困难决策位置，从而更好地分配推理时计算资源；RLVR的推理轨迹可通过蒸馏传递给基础模型。

Conclusion: 强化学习微调（RLVR）相比监督微调（SFT）在推理能力上的优势源于前者能学习高效回溯策略，这导致两者在推理时计算复杂度上存在指数级差距，且RLVR的知识可通过蒸馏传播。

Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated that reinforcement fine-tuning of pretrained base models can lead to significant gains in reasoning performance at inference time. In this work, we theoretically analyze why reinforcement fine-tuning induces better reasoning ability than purely supervised fine-tuning (SFT) methods. We model chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning as a pathfinding problem on graphs and compare the popular method of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) against traditional SFT. We prove that SFT, when trained on golden shortest paths without negative examples, fails to learn how to efficiently backtrack. In contrast, an RLVR-trained model can learn how to efficiently backtrack from dead ends using only outcome reward. This leads to an exponential separation in inference-time compute between the two methods, and demonstrates that RLVR leads the model to learn the location of difficult decisions in a reasoning chain, ultimately allowing for better allocation of inference-time compute. Finally, we show that the reasoning traces of an RLVR model can be distilled to train a base model to backtrack efficiently as well.

</details>


### [231] [Neural Operator Processes for Probabilistic Operator Learning under Partial Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22946)
*Jose Miguel Lara-Rangel,Serge Guillas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出神经算子过程（NOPs），统一神经过程条件化与神经算子解码，从稀疏、不规则或部分观测中预测完整输出场，在函数回归和三个PDE基准上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子通常需要稠密的输入-输出训练场和完整观测输入，而许多科学问题需要在不确定性下从稀疏、不规则或部分观测中预测解场。

Method: 提出NOPs框架，将神经过程的条件化机制与神经算子的解码能力统一，在共享的编码器-解码器架构中支持确定性及概率性预测；研究了两种条件化策略：卷积池化摘要和查询对齐注意力。

Result: 稀疏条件算子学习可行，可在多种情况下匹配稠密网格表现；非周期设置下保持局部上下文-查询几何结构至关重要，而谱平滑周期设置下则不然；当潜在条件化补充而非覆盖局部几何路径时，不确定性感知算子学习方能成功。

Conclusion: 为部分观测下的概率算子学习提供了基础，有助于桥接算子学习与函数空间中的概率元学习。

Abstract: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, but are typically developed with dense input-output training fields and fully observed inputs at inference. Many scientific problems require instead predicting solution fields from sparse, irregular, or partial observations under uncertainty. We introduce Neural Operator Processes (NOPs), a framework that unifies neural-process conditioning with neural-operator decoding to predict full output fields from limited context. NOPs condition on sparse joint input-output observations and support deterministic and probabilistic prediction within a shared encoder-decoder architecture. We study two conditioning strategies, convolutional pooled summaries and query-aligned attention, and analyze how their interaction with latent stochastic variables depends on PDE geometry. Across function regression and three PDE benchmarks, we find that sparse conditional operator learning is viable and can match dense-grid behavior in several regimes, that preserving local context-query geometry is essential in non-periodic settings but less so in spectrally smooth periodic regimes, and that uncertainty-aware operator learning succeeds when latent conditioning complements rather than overwrites the local geometric pathway. These results provide a basis for probabilistic operator learning under partial observations and help bridge operator learning and probabilistic meta-learning in function space.

</details>


### [232] [DT-GOL: Dual-Track Geometric Online Learning in Nonstationary Environment with Label Delay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22950)
*Yulin Wang,Yi He,Dianlong You,Di Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对在线学习中标签延迟导致无法快速适应动态环境的问题，提出DT-GOL框架，通过双轨几何在线学习将时序补偿转为空间推理，利用实时拓扑演化作为几何代理实现延迟窗口内的主动监督适应，并设计解耦双轨架构解决稳定性-可塑性困境，实验显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线学习在处理大数据流时面临动态环境（非平稳环境）的挑战，而标签延迟（新数据因标注过程缓慢昂贵而无法及时获得标签）是一个关键但常被忽视的问题，阻碍了对动态环境的快速适应。

Method: 提出DT-GOL框架：1) 将延迟挑战建模为半监督任务，利用特征实时拓扑演化作为概念变化的几何代理；2) 引入动态证据校准机制，将几何信息蒸馏为感知不确定性的软标签，缓解硬伪标签的确认偏差；3) 设计解耦双轨架构，主学习器由延迟真值严格更新作为稳定锚点，瞬态分支利用软几何知识进行低风险前向适应。

Result: 在真实与合成数据集上的大量实验表明，DT-GOL显著优于现有最先进基线方法，尤其在概念漂移场景中表现突出。

Conclusion: DT-GOL通过从时序补偿转向空间推理，有效解决了标签延迟下的在线学习问题，其双轨架构平衡了稳定性与可塑性，在动态环境中展现出优越的适应性。

Abstract: Online learning is crucial for handling complex data streams in big data applications. Recent research has begun to focus on dynamic scenarios, i.e., non-stationary environments. However, a crucial yet often overlooked aspect is label latency, where new data may not receive labels in time due to the slow and expensive labeling process, thus hindering rapid adaptation to dynamic environments.
  To resolve this impasse, we propose Dual-Track Geometry Online Learning (DT-GOL), a novel framework that shifts from temporal compensation to spatial reasoning to bridge the supervised latency gap. By modeling the delay challenge as a semi-supervised task, we leverage real-time topological evolution of features as a reliable geometric surrogate for unobservable conceptual changes to achieve proactive supervised adaptation within the delay window. Unlike rigid self-training, we introduce a dynamic evidence calibration mechanism that distills geometric information into soft labels that perceive uncertainty, effectively mitigating the confirmation bias inherent in hard pseudo-labels. Furthermore, to resolve the stability-plasticity dilemma, we design a decoupled dual-track architecture in which a master learner serves as a stable anchor, updated strictly from delayed ground truth, while a transient branch leverages soft geometric knowledge for low-risk forward adaptation. Extensive experiments on real and synthetic datasets demonstrate that DT-GOL significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art baseline methods, especially in scenarios with concept drift.

</details>


### [233] [PG-MAP: Joint MAP Optimization for Inference-Time Alignment of Diffusion and Flow-Matching Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22958)
*Ruolan Sun,Pawel Polak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PG-MAP是一个无需训练的推理时对齐框架，通过对条件c和隐状态z_t进行联合轨迹级Gibbs-MAP/近端能量优化，在扩散模型和流匹配模型上显著提升文本到图像生成的对齐质量（如PickScore 91.9%、HPS 75.7%胜率），并揭示了条件与隐变量优化的相对重要性随提示类型变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理时对齐方法（如无分类器引导、注意力编辑、基于奖励的潜变量扰动）仅在单一控制轴上操作，无法建模条件变量与隐变量之间的联合依赖关系，且难以在不同生成传输模型（扩散模型与流匹配模型）之间迁移。为此，本文提出一种统一的训练-free框架，实现跨模态的协调更新。

Method: PG-MAP框架将推理时对齐形式化为轨迹级Gibbs-MAP/近端能量优化，通过前向一致性耦合对条件c和隐状态z_t进行联合优化，可选地由冻结的偏好奖励引导。针对扩散模型和流匹配模型分别设计传输特定的适配：扩散模型上全联合优化，流匹配模型上简化为仅隐变量变体。

Result: 在扩散模型（SD 1.5, SDXL）上，PG-MAP持续提升PickScore和Aesthetic等对齐指标，并能与调优后的CFG结合达到最强性能。在流匹配模型（SD3.5-medium）上，隐变量变体实现91.9% PickScore和75.7% HPS胜率。消融实验排除了噪声伪影。人工评估确认了相对于强基线（调优CFG、通用引导）的偏好。Oracle路由分析表明条件与隐变量优化的相对重要性取决于提示类型。

Conclusion: PG-MAP证明了联合优化条件与隐变量在推理时对齐中的有效性，揭示了不同提示类型对优化维度的不同需求，为未来按提示选择优化策略（per-prompt selector）提供了改进空间。

Abstract: Inference-time alignment of pretrained text-to-image models is typically performed along a single control axis, such as classifier-free guidance, attention editing, or reward-based latent perturbations. This limitation prevents modeling joint dependencies between conditioning and latent variables and hinders transfer across generative transports. We propose PG-MAP, a training-free framework that formulates inference-time alignment as a trajectory-level Gibbs-MAP / proximal energy optimization over the conditioning $c$ and latent state $z_t$ via a forward-consistency coupling, optionally guided by a frozen preference reward. This joint formulation enables coordinated updates across modalities while remaining compatible with both diffusion and flow-matching models through transport-specific adaptations. Across diffusion backbones (SD~1.5, SDXL), PG-MAP consistently improves alignment metrics such as PickScore and Aesthetic, and can be effectively combined with tuned classifier-free guidance to achieve the strongest overall performance. On flow-matching models (SD3.5-medium), the framework reduces to a latent-only variant, achieving $\mathbf{91.9\%}$ PickScore and $75.7\%$ HPS win rates against a static baseline, with controlled experiments ruling out noise-related artifacts. Human evaluations further confirm consistent preference over strong baselines, including tuned CFG and compute-matched universal guidance. Finally, an oracle-routing analysis shows that the relative importance of conditioning and latent optimization depends on prompt types, surfacing further headroom that a per-prompt selector could exploit.

</details>


### [234] [Attacking the Trusted Imagination: Oracle-Level Integrity Attacks on Imagine-then-Act World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22966)
*Linghan Chen,Kaiyan Ji,Minyu Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中世界-动作模型（WAM）的“想象”模块存在安全漏洞：攻击者可通过观测扰动轻易将潜想象轨迹偏移出自然流形，实现无目标攻击（强度约为随机的60倍，检测AUC=1.0），但难以进行精确的目标控制；下游依赖该想象的系统（如视觉MPC规划器）会因此失效（epsilon=0.01时成功率从0.70降至0.05），而反应式策略本身仍保持鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA策略普遍采用"先想象后行动"的设计范式，但前人未充分研究想象模块作为攻击面的安全风险。本文发现世界-动作模型（WAM）生成的潜想象轨迹被下游系统（安全门、视觉MPC、验证器）作为未来预测直接使用，构成不对称的攻击面：破坏想象容易而精确控制难，需要系统性评估这种安全漏洞。

Method: 采用基于能力的威胁模型，设置L-infinity有界观测扰动。攻击者通过完全可微的观测到想象映射执行投影梯度下降（PGD）。利用离流形特性设计参数自由去噪检测器。在RynnVLA-002、LingBot-VA和LaDi-WM三个目标上评估无目标破坏、目标控制和自适应攻击三种攻击类型。

Result: 无目标破坏强度约为随机扰动的60倍，检测AUC达到1.0；目标控制攻击效果有限；自适应攻击者只能放弃破坏以避免检测。反应式策略对损坏想象保持鲁棒，但原生想象驱动MPC出现首个攻击特定任务失败（epsilon=0.01时，成功率0.70 vs 0.05，Fisher p<10^-4）。

Conclusion: WAM的想象模块是暴露的攻击面，离流形特性导致无目标攻击极易且可被完美检测，但目标控制受限；下游依赖想象的系统比反应式策略更脆弱，需要对此类系统体系进行独立的安全性评估与加固。

Abstract: Many recent vision-language-action (VLA) policies adopt an imagine-then-act design. A world-action model (WAM) first imagines a short future as a latent trajectory z~, on which the action is then conditioned. We identify this trusted imagination, rather than the reactive policy, as the exposed attack surface. A downstream oracle, such as a safety gate, a visual model-predictive-control (MPC) planner, or an imagine-then-check verifier, consumes z~ as a prediction of the future. The robustness of the policy therefore does not entail the robustness of systems that rely on the WAM. The underlying phenomenon is an asymmetry. Corrupting the imagination is easy, since it requires only displacing z~ from its natural-future manifold. Steering it precisely is hard, since it must reach a specified on-manifold target. We adopt a capability-based threat model with an L-infinity-bounded observation perturbation. The attacker applies projected gradient descent through the fully differentiable observation-to-imagination map. The same off-manifold property motivates a parameter-free denoiser detector. We evaluate three targets: RynnVLA-002, LingBot-VA, and LaDi-WM. Untargeted corruption is roughly 60x stronger than random and is detected at AUC 1.0. Targeted control remains bounded. An adaptive attacker evades detection only by forgoing corruption. The reactive policy remains robust to corrupted imagination. A native imagination-driven MPC, however, exhibits the first adversary-specific task failure (at epsilon=0.01, success 0.70 versus 0.05; Fisher p < 10^-4).

</details>


### [235] [Topological Out-of-Domain Generalization in Dynamical Systems Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22969)
*Georg Trede,Charlotte Ricarda Doll,Elias Weber,Daniel Durstewitz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析了现有基于层次结构和超网络的动力系统重构方法在跨临界点等域外预测中的根本局限性，识别了三个核心缺陷（模型结构假设与物理系统特性不匹配），提出以特征分裂为主的组合修复方案，并推导了可靠外推范围的闭式界，实现了对新动力学区域的零样本准确预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动力系统预测在科学机器学习中一个关键但未解决的问题是：如何超越训练中观察到的动力学和参数范围进行预测（如跨临界点）。现有层次化和超网络引导的模型虽然能同时训练多个DS，但在真正的域外预测（如跨越 tipping points）方面能力有限，通常需要微调或完全重新训练。

Method: 首先对现有模型公式进行数学分析，识别三个核心缺陷：重建模型的结构假设与物理系统典型属性之间的不匹配。然后提出组合修复方案，最重要的是特征分裂（feature splitting）。此外，推导了可靠外推范围的闭式界（closed-form bound）。

Result: 所提技术实现了对新的动力学区域（如跨越 tipping points）的准确零样本预测，即无需在新动力学区域的时间序列上进行微调或重新训练。

Conclusion: 通过特征分裂等修复方案，解决了现有方法在跨动力学区域预测上的根本限制，使得模型能够真正实现零样本域外泛化，这对于科学理论中利用有限数据进行超越观测范围的预测具有重要价值。

Abstract: Predicting the behavior of dynamical systems (DS) beyond the dynamical and parameter regimes observed in training is a pivotal and essentially unresolved problem in scientific ML. It is central to any good scientific theory, which we expect to be able to make predictions about regimes not covered by currently available data. Recent hierarchical and hyper-network guided approaches for DS reconstruction (DSR) enable training on many DS simultaneously, and revealed that extracted latent features are often related to crucial control parameters of the underlying DS that varied across the training corpus. However, true out-of-domain forecasting abilities of these models, e.g., across tipping points, remain limited, and fine-tuning, or even full model retraining, on time series from the new dynamical regime is usually required. Here, we mathematically analyze the root of these limitations in previous model formulations and identify three core shortcomings rooted in a mismatch between structural assumptions of the reconstruction model and typical properties of physical systems. We propose a combination of remedies for these shortcomings, most importantly feature splitting, and furthermore derive a closed-form bound on the reliable extrapolation range. We demonstrate empirically that our techniques allow for accurate zero-shot prediction into new dynamical regimes, outside the observed training regime, as, e.g., encountered across tipping points.

</details>


### [236] [TaLK: Text-attributed Graph Dataset Distillation via Coupling Language Model with Graph-Aware Kernel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22975)
*Yeongho Kim,Yeonje Choi,Kijung Shin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TaLK是一种面向文本属性图的高效数据集蒸馏方法，通过将语言模型与图感知神经切线核耦合，避免了对完整数据集的重复联合训练，仅用1%合成数据即可达到完整数据集97%的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本属性图学习方法需要联合训练语言模型和图神经网络，计算开销大且难以扩展；现有的数据集蒸馏方法要么针对单模态设计，要么在蒸馏过程中仍需在完整数据集上反复训练昂贵的LM-GNN模型，不适合TAG场景。

Method: 提出TaLK方法，将语言模型与图感知神经切线核（graph-aware NTK）耦合，从而实现高效的数据集蒸馏，在蒸馏过程中无需对完整数据集进行重复的LM-GNN联合训练，同时保留文本和结构信息。

Result: 在多个TAG基准数据集上，TaLK一致优于现有基线方法，仅使用1%的合成数据即可达到完整数据集性能的97%。

Conclusion: TaLK通过LM与图感知NTK的耦合设计，有效解决了TAG数据集蒸馏中的多模态信息保留和计算效率问题，为大规模TAG学习提供了一种高效的蒸馏方案。

Abstract: Text-attributed graphs (TAGs) are widely used in many real-world domains, and learning on TAGs requires jointly modeling text semantics and graph structure. A standard approach for modeling TAGs is to combine a language model (LM) and a graph neural network (GNN), but joint training is computationally expensive and difficult to scale. Dataset distillation is a promising way to reduce training costs, but existing methods are not well suited to TAGs because they are typically designed for a single modality or still require repeatedly training expensive LM-GNN models on the full dataset during distillation. To address this, we propose TaLK, an effective dataset distillation method for TAGs that couples an LM with a graph-aware neural tangent kernel.This design enables efficient dataset distillation, avoiding repeated joint training on the full dataset while reflecting both textual and structural information for effective TAG learning.Experiments on multiple TAG benchmarks show that TaLK consistently outperforms existing baselines and achieves up to 97% of full-dataset performance with only 1% synthetic data.

</details>


### [237] [Understanding Parallel Samplers in Masked Diffusion via Random Walks on Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22976)
*Vansh Bansal,Cho Cholyeon,Syamantak Kumar,Sujay Sanghavi,Purnamrita Sarkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出以图上的随机游走作为可验证的沙箱环境，研究掩码扩散模型中的不同并行采样策略。通过在固定图上训练MDM，利用图结构作为可控的潜在序列结构进行定量评估，并证明了常见并行采样策略（如最低熵）并非普遍优于随机采样，其性能依赖于图结构。作者开发了一种新的二分采样器，在序列长度上呈对数步数，且在完美训练下精确。实验表明不同并行采样器在不同图上表现各异，且在语言生成任务中，二分风格采样器能改善速度-质量权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前掩码扩散模型中存在多种并行采样策略，但缺乏一个可受控、可定量评估的统一框架来衡量其优劣。现有评估方式通常依赖于复杂的真实数据分布，难以隔离采样策略本身的效果。作者希望构建一个类似数独验证的沙箱环境，将图结构作为可控的潜在序列结构，从而严格比较不同并行采样策略的性能。

Method: 1) 将固定图上的随机游走序列作为MDM的训练数据，图结构对模型隐式。2) 理论上证明不同图结构下并行采样策略（如最低熵）并非一致最优。3) 提出二分采样器（bisection sampler），在序列长度上仅需对数步数，且在完美训练下可保证精确采样。4) 在多种图游走任务和OpenWebText预训练MDM上进行实验验证。

Result: 理论证明表明并行采样策略的效果关键依赖于底层图结构，最低熵等策略并非普遍优于随机并行采样。提出的二分采样器在完美训练下可精确采样，且步数为对数级别。实验验证了不同图需要不同并行采样策略，且在真实语言生成任务上，二分风格采样器改善了速度-质量权衡。

Conclusion: 图随机游走可作为诊断和设计掩码扩散模型并行采样器的机械化基准平台。该框架提供了可控、可验证的评估环境，有助于更深入地理解不同采样策略的优缺点，并为设计更高效的并行采样方法提供了新方向。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose using random walks on graphs as a verifiable sandbox to study different parallel sampling strategies in masked diffusion models (MDMs). We train an MDM on random walk samples from a fixed graph. The graph or the transition kernel is never shown to the model explicitly and plays the role of latent structure in the sequences, albeit one that is controllable and can be used for quantitative evaluation. Thus, this framework enjoys a Sudoku-like validity check: verifying that an output is a valid walk and estimating the Markov kernel from the walks to measure distribution fidelity.
  Using simple graphs, we theoretically prove that parallel unmasking via widely used scores like lowest entropy is not uniformly better than a random parallel sampler; the performance critically depends on the structure of the underlying graph. We develop a new bisection sampler for random walks, which takes logarithmic steps in the sequence length and is provably exact under perfect training. Experiments on various graph walk tasks show that different parallel samplers are better for different graphs even in practice. Our initial experiments on a pretrained OpenWebText MDM show that the bisection-style samplers improve speed-quality tradeoffs even for language generation. Together, these results position graph random walks as a mechanistic benchmark for diagnosing and designing parallel samplers for masked diffusion models.

</details>


### [238] [Neural Architecture Search of Sample Reweighting Networks for Complex Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22991)
*Keisuke Sugawara,Kento Uchida,Shinichi Shirakawa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对MW-Net在同时面临标签噪声和类别不平衡时性能下降的问题，引入神经架构搜索（NAS）来自动优化MW-Net的网络结构（隐藏层数、节点数）和输入特征层，在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MW-Net在单一分布偏移下表现良好，但在同时存在标签噪声和类别不平衡时，仅靠分类损失和简单网络难以确定合适的样本权重，导致性能下降。

Method: 采用基于树结构Parzen估计器的神经架构搜索，探索MW-Net的最优隐藏层数和节点数，并选择分类模型中最合适的中间层作为MW-Net的输入。

Result: 在同时包含标签噪声和类别不平衡的CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据集上，NAS增强的MW-Net显著提升了性能。

Conclusion: 神经架构搜索能有效提升MW-Net在复杂分布偏移场景下的样本重加权能力。

Abstract: Sample reweighting is a major approach to addressing distribution shifts, such as label noise and class imbalance. Meta-Weight-Net (MW-Net) is a promising sample reweighting network that computes weights based on classification loss. Although MW-Net improves prediction performance under a single type of distribution shift using a simple neural network, its performance degrades when facing both label noise and class imbalance, where it is hard to determine appropriate weights solely from classification loss and using a simple network. In this study, we introduce neural architecture search to MW-Net to mitigate such performance degradation. Using the tree-structured Parzen estimator, we explore the optimal number of hidden layers and nodes and select the most suitable intermediate layer in the classification model to serve as the input for MW-Net. Experimental results on the CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 datasets that were modified to include both label noise and class imbalance demonstrate the effectiveness of neural architecture search for MW-Net.

</details>


### [239] [Do Sparse Autoencoders Learn Meaningful Concept Hierarchies?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22994)
*Nils Grandien,David Steinmann,Felix Friedrich,Kristian Kersting*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏自编码器（SAE）中层级结构的评估问题，提出了一套基于语义网络和分类学研究的通用/特化层级需求，并设计了具体评估协议。通过在视觉数据的SAE方法上应用该协议，发现虽然特征空间能支持合理的层级结构，但建立良好层级结构仍具挑战性，尤其是特征吸收（包括硬吸收和连续软吸收）会系统性地损害层级质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SAE层级结构方法缺乏统一的评估标准，主要依赖定性说明和零散的定量协议，无法进行严格比较。因此需要建立一套公认的层级结构需求。

Method: 从语义网络和分类学研究以及近期SAE工作中推导出通用/特化层级的关键需求，据此设计具体的评估协议，并在视觉数据上的当前SAE方法中进行实证应用。

Result: 特征空间总体上能为合理的层级结构提供基础，但构建良好层级结构仍然困难。特征吸收（包括硬吸收和连续软吸收）是系统性地损害层级质量的关键因素。

Conclusion: 未来SAE方法需要解决特征吸收带来的根本性矛盾，以建立更高质量的层级结构。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have become an important tool for unsupervised concept discovery in large models. To make the resulting feature spaces more interpretable and manageable, recent approaches have begun imposing hierarchical structure, either explicitly or as an implicit effect of training constraints, yet rigorous comparison remains difficult. There are no agreed-upon requirements for what a meaningful feature hierarchy should satisfy, and evaluation has largely relied on qualitative illustrations with fragmented quantitative protocols. To address this, we derive a set of key requirements for generalization/specialization hierarchies in unsupervised concept discovery, drawing on semantic net and taxonomy research alongside recent SAE work, and use them to derive a concrete evaluation protocol. Applying this protocol to current SAE approaches trained on visual data, we find that while feature spaces generally provide a basis for sensible hierarchies, establishing good hierarchical structure remains challenging. In particular, feature absorption, both in its well-known hard form and in a continuous, soft form, systematically compromises hierarchy quality, pointing to a fundamental tension that future approaches will need to navigate.

</details>


### [240] [Group-Graph Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22995)
*Yunan Wang,Minghui Song,Zihan Zhang,Shaohan Huang,Haizhen Huang,Furu Wei,Weiwei Deng,Feng Sun,Qi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: G2PO通过将线性交互轨迹转换为全局状态转移图，采用组聚合状态值估计和边中心优势估计策略，解决了长程智能体强化学习中的奖励稀疏和信用分配问题，在多个基准上相比GRPO提升高达22.2%的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于组的强化学习框架在智能体场景中虽已从轨迹级转向步级训练，但长程任务中仍存在严重的奖励稀疏与延迟问题，且信用分配粗粒度，将智能体探索视为孤立的线性轨迹，忽略了状态转移的图结构，导致状态值估计高方差和短视的局部信用分配。

Method: G2PO将线性交互轨迹显式转换为全局状态转移图，通过聚合跨轨迹的相同观测引入组聚合状态值估计以降低采样方差和轨迹依赖偏差；将动作重定义为状态节点间的边，提出边中心优势估计策略，在整个图上全局标准化TD误差，识别并优先更新驱动绝对任务进展的关键转移。

Result: 在WebShop、ALFWorld和AppWorld三个长程基准上，G2PO显著优于SOTA的基于提示和RL的基线方法，相较于GRPO取得高达22.2%的成功率提升。

Conclusion: G2PO通过图结构化的信用分配机制有效解决了长程智能体强化学习中的奖励稀疏和信用分配瓶颈，验证了将轨迹建模为状态转移图相比线性轨迹处理的优越性。

Abstract: Group-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) has significantly enhanced Large Language Models (LLMs) in agentic scenarios. To achieve finer-grained policy updates, recent agentic RL frameworks have shifted from trajectory-level to step-level training. However, long-horizon agentic RL suffers from severe reward sparsity and delay, as feedback is often deferred for dozens of interaction steps. While existing step-level frameworks refine training granularity, their credit assignment remains coarse-grained and still treats agent exploration as isolated, linear trajectories. This oversimplified perspective ignores the inherent graph structure of state transitions, leading to high-variance state-value estimation and myopic, localized credit assignment. To overcome these critical bottlenecks, we propose Group-Graph Policy Optimization (G2PO), a novel group-based RL algorithm tailored for multi-turn agentic tasks. G2PO explicitly transforms linear interaction trajectories into a global state-transition graph. By aggregating identical observations across different trajectories, we introduce group-aggregation state-value estimation that reduces sampling variance and trajectory-dependent bias. Furthermore, we redefine agent actions as transitions between state nodes and propose an edge-centric advantage estimation strategy. By globally standardizing Temporal Difference (TD) errors across the entire graph, G2PO explicitly identifies and prioritizes critical transitions that drive absolute task progress. Extensive experiments on representative long-horizon benchmarks-WebShop, ALFWorld, and AppWorld-demonstrate that G2PO substantially outperforms state-of-the-art prompt-based and RL baselines, achieving remarkable success rate improvements of up to 22.2% over GRPO.

</details>


### [241] [A Novel Approach to Temporal QoS Estimation via Extended Kalman Filter-Incorporated Latent Feature Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23010)
*Ye Yuan,Song Wang,Hongxun Zhou,Ling Wang,Xin Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种扩展卡尔曼滤波增强的潜在特征分析（EKL）模型，用于高效准确地预测时序QoS数据，通过双向模型-数据驱动学习，在真实数据集上超越了现有最先进模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主流方法采用纯数据驱动方式，难以捕捉非平稳时序模式，当地时序QoS数据出现波动时预测精度下降。

Method: EKL模型包含三个核心设计：(a) 基于扩展卡尔曼滤波的模型驱动特征生成器，捕捉时序潜在特征；(b) 基于交替最小二乘算法的数据驱动特征生成器，识别时不变潜在特征；(c) 基于密度导向的并行策略，按服务调用密度对用户排序以实现负载均衡，提升计算效率。

Result: 在真实时序QoS数据集上的实验表明，EKL在计算效率和缺失时序QoS数据的预测精度两方面均超越了现有最先进模型。

Conclusion: EKL通过双向模型-数据驱动学习范式，结合扩展卡尔曼滤波与潜在特征分析，有效解决了纯数据驱动方法在非平稳时序预测中的局限性，并提供了收敛性的理论证明。

Abstract: Predicting temporal Quality of Service (QoS) data is critical for optimizing network services and rationalizing resource allocation in cloud computing and service-oriented systems. Existing mainstream methods have achieved promising predictive performance. However, their purely data-driven manner limits their ability to capture non-stationary temporal patterns, thereby leading to accuracy degradation when temporal QoS data exhibits fluctuations. To tackle this limitation, we propose a novel Extended Kalman Filter-Enhanced Latent Feature Analysis (EKL) model to perform efficient and accurate temporal QoS prediction from the perspective of bidirectional model-data-driven learning. Its main idea is three-fold: a) designing a model-driven feature producer to obtain the temporal latent features to capture the intricate temporal pattern following the principle of an Extended Kalman Filter; b) building a data-driven feature producer based on the alternating least squares algorithm to identify time-invariant latent features describing intrinsic user-service characteristics; c) exploiting a density-oriented parallel strategy that achieves workload balancing by sorting users in accordance with their service invocation density, which effectively elevates computational efficiency. In addition, we provide a rigorous theoretical analysis to formally prove the convergence of the proposed EKL. Experimental evaluations conducted on real-world temporal QoS datasets reveal that our proposed EKL surpasses existing state-of-the-art models with respect to both computational efficiency and prediction accuracy for missing temporal QoS data.

</details>


### [242] [Counterfactual learning of new adaptive instructional policies using logged data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23015)
*Samuel Girard,Sein Minn,Amel Bouzeghoub,Jill-Jênn Vie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种离线上下文 Bandit 框架，利用 Rasch 模型将学生-题目交互映射到连续潜在能力-难度空间，通过设计优化"心流"的奖励函数，从历史交互数据中直接学习新的自适应教学策略，在四个大规模真实数据集上实现了策略改进，且计算仅需数秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在智能辅导系统中优化教学策略通常需要昂贵的在线实验或可能无法捕捉真实动态的学生模拟器，本文旨在直接从历史交互数据中学习新策略，避免额外数据收集的高成本。

Method: 采用离线上下文 Bandit 框架，利用 Rasch 模型将学生-题目交互映射到连续潜在能力-难度空间，将辅导过程建模为连续随机 Bandit 问题，设计优化"心流"（平衡任务挑战与学生成功）的奖励函数，并包含轮次特定的行为策略评估，同时作为倾向模型用于离线策略评估和 ITS 自适应诊断工具。

Result: 在四个大规模真实数据集上，该方法相较于记录的行为策略取得了一致的策略改进，且策略学习和可视化仅需数秒计算时间。

Conclusion: 有效的教学策略可以从历史数据中快速学习和可视化，无需进一步数据收集，为改进自适应学习系统提供了一种可扩展的路径。

Abstract: Optimizing instructional policies in Intelligent Tutoring Systems (ITS) typically requires costly online experimentation or student simulators that may fail to capture real-world dynamics. This paper introduces an offline contextual bandit framework that learns new adaptive policies directly from logged interaction data. By mapping student-item interactions onto a continuous latent proficiency-difficulty scale using a Rasch model, we cast the tutoring process as a continuous stochastic bandit problem. We propose a novel reward function designed to optimize ''flow'' by balancing task challenge with student success. Our approach includes a round-specific behavior policy estimation that serves as both a propensity model for off-policy evaluation and a diagnostic tool for ITS adaptivity. We demonstrate the efficacy of this framework across four large-scale real-world datasets, achieving consistent policy improvements over the logged behavior policy. The results show that effective instructional policies can be learned and visualized within seconds of computation, providing a scalable path for improving adaptive learning systems without further data collection.

</details>


### [243] [EvoRubrics: Dynamic Rubrics as Rewards via Adversarial Co-Evolution for LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23038)
*Hongxin Ding,Baixiang Huang,Yue Fang,Weibin Liao,Zheng Li,Jinyang Zhang,Zhijing Wu,Junfeng Zhao,Yasha Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EvoRubrics提出了一种策略LLM与评分生成器协同进化的强化学习框架，通过在每一训练步骤中对抗性交互，使评分标准随策略提升而动态适应，解决了固定评分标准在开放任务中逐渐失效的问题，实验表明该方法优于静态和动态评分基线，且完全自监督版本也能取得有意义的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于评分标准的奖励在开放任务中提供了可解释的细粒度优化信号，但固定评分标准随着策略提升逐渐失去判别力，导致奖励饱和与潜在欺骗。现有动态评分方法依赖外部前沿模型或标准答案，且仅以粗粒度更新评分标准。

Method: 提出EvoRubrics共演化强化学习框架，包含策略LLM和评分生成器两个角色，通过每个训练步骤内的对抗性交互实现协同改进：策略在评分指导下提升，评分生成器动态调整标准以保持判别力和信息量，自然形成自动课程学习。

Result: EvoRubrics在多个基准上一致优于静态和动态评分基线；学到的评分生成器可作为可迁移的奖励模型泛化到新任务；完全自监督变体（无任何外部监督）也能取得有意义的性能提升。

Conclusion: 生成与评估之间的共演化本身即可提供足够丰富的学习信号，无需外部监督；该方法有效解决了固定评分标准与进化策略之间的失配问题。

Abstract: Rubric-based rewards offer interpretable and fine-grained optimization signals for reinforcement learning in open-ended tasks where verifiable answers are unavailable. However, pre-constructed rubrics remain static throughout training, creating a fundamental mismatch with the evolving policy: fixed criteria gradually lose discriminative power as the model improves, leading to reward saturation and potential hacking. Recent dynamic rubric methods partially address this but rely on external frontier models or ground-truth answers, and update rubrics only at coarse granularity. We propose EvoRubrics, a co-evolutionary RL framework where a Policy LLM and a Rubric Generator jointly improve through adversarial interaction within each training step. As the policy improves under the rubric generator's guidance, the rubric generator adapts its criteria to remain discriminative and informative, enabling evaluation to track the policy in real time and naturally inducing an automatic curriculum. Experiments show that EvoRubrics consistently outperforms static and dynamic rubric baselines across benchmarks. The learned Rubric Generator further generalizes as a transferable reward model. Notably, even a fully self-supervised variant without any external supervision achieves meaningful gains, suggesting that co-evolution between generation and evaluation alone can provide sufficiently rich learning signals. Our code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/EvoRubrics-2155/.

</details>


### [244] [Prime Fourier Embeddings: A Principled Basis for Modular Arithmetic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23044)
*Hyunsang Hwang,Suhyun Bae,Donghun Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出素数傅里叶嵌入（PFE），通过素数索引的正弦-余弦对编码整数，使模运算简化为选择相关素数通道，并利用舒尔引理和中国剩余定理证明其代数结构优势，实验显示任务相关通道与无关通道的特化比超过500倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准神经嵌入难以揭示数字的代数结构，尤其无法高效处理模运算等代数任务，因此需要一种预结构化的表示方法。

Method: PFE将整数编码为素数索引的(cos, sin)对，基于有理数域的调和分析；利用舒尔引理证明任何与PFE乘积群作用等变的线性映射必为块对角阵（每素数一个独立块）；利用中国剩余定理预测模复合数时哪些素数通道是任务相关的。

Result: 消融实验显示任务相关通道与无关通道的特化比超过500倍；在所有测试的无平方因子复合模数上，分布内测试准确率达到完美（100%）。

Conclusion: PFE通过显式的代数结构嵌入而非从头学习，能高效实现模运算，且理论预测与实验吻合，为神经符号表示提供了新范式。

Abstract: Numbers have algebraic structure that standard neural embeddings often fail to expose. We introduce Prime Fourier Embeddings (PFE), which encode integers as prime-indexed (cos, sin) pairs derived from the harmonic analysis of Q, providing a pre-structured representation in which modular arithmetic reduces to selecting the relevant prime channel rather than discovering algebraic structure from scratch. We prove that any linear map equivariant with respect to the product group action on PFE must be block-diagonal with one independent block per prime -- a consequence of Schur's lemma applied to the resulting character decomposition. For square-free composite moduli, the Chinese Remainder Theorem predicts which prime channels are task-relevant. Both predictions are confirmed empirically: ablation studies show specialization ratios exceeding 500x between task-relevant and task-irrelevant channels, with perfect in-distribution test accuracy across all square-free composite moduli tested.

</details>


### [245] [PeLAP-A: Adaptive Latent Pruning for Lightweight Latent Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23086)
*Kissa Zahra,Zaib Un Nisa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 PeLAP-A 框架，通过可学习的通道重要性预测器在潜空间中剪枝冗余通道。实验发现，即使将所有潜通道压制到接近零，去噪 UNet 仍能保持甚至提升性能，揭示了潜扩散模型存在"稀疏崩塌"现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究潜扩散模型中所有潜通道是否对扩散过程同等重要，是否存在显著冗余，以及去噪 UNet 对通道抑制的鲁棒性边界。

Method: 提出 PeLAP-A 轻量级框架：在 VAE 编码器与去噪 UNet 之间插入一个两层的 MLP 作为通道重要性预测器，基于全局池化的潜特征生成软掩码，联合训练扩散损失、重建损失和稀疏损失。

Result: 在 CIFAR-10 上，强稀疏正则化（λ=0.01）导致所有潜通道权重接近零（稀疏崩塌），但扩散损失（0.0236 vs 0.0240）和 VAE 重建 MSE（22.59 vs 24.67）均优于未剪枝基线。

Conclusion: 发现潜扩散模型存在"稀疏崩塌"现象，表明去噪 UNet 对潜通道抑制具有显著鲁棒性，潜空间中存在大量冗余信息；该发现为潜扩散模型的机制理解和模型压缩提供了新视角。

Abstract: Latent diffusion models achieve strong generative performance by operating in a compressed latent space produced by a variational autoencoder (VAE). However, it remains unclear whether all latent channels contribute equally to the diffusion process, or whether significant redundancy exists. We introduce PeLAP-A (Adaptive Latent Pruning for Diffusion), a lightweight framework that augments a standard latent diffusion pipeline with a learnable channel-wise importance predictor. A two-layer MLP operating on globally pooled latent features produces a soft mask that suppresses unimportant latent channels before they enter the denoising UNet. The entire system is trained jointly on CIFAR-10 under a combined diffusion, reconstruction, and sparsity loss. Experiments reveal a striking result: under aggressive sparsity regularization (lambda = 0.01), the importance predictor drives all latent channels to near-zero yet the denoising UNet achieves lower diffusion loss (0.0236 vs. 0.0240) and lower VAE reconstruction MSE (22.59 vs. 24.67) compared to the unpruned baseline. We term this the sparsity collapse phenomenon and provide an analysis of why it occurs and what it reveals about the information requirements of latent diffusion models. These findings constitute an exploratory study of sparsity dynamics in latent diffusion training, and demonstrate that denoising UNets can remain remarkably robust to latent channel suppression even under aggressive regularization. Code is available at: https://github.com/kissasium/PeLAP-A.git.

</details>


### [246] [FlowTrain: Flow-Based Decoupled Training for Industrial-Grade Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23087)
*Zhida Jiang,Zhaolong Xing,Yang Pei,Xiaolong Chen,Yuanhang Xiao,Chengzhi Huang,Xiyu Liu,Haopeng Liu,Qingyuan Sang,Lingfeng Zhou,Jiaxing Wang,Zicheng Zhang,Wenzhe Wang,Xinyu Liu,Yan Li,Zhen Chen,Ke Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlowTrain提出了一种基于数据流的解耦训练框架，将VLM训练重构为通过统一内存池协调的生产者-消费者数据流，使编码器和骨干网络在全局虚拟地址空间上独立推进，并引入异构并行分配器和动态打包调度器，实现了超过50%的MFU和最高1.7倍的吞吐量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业级视觉-语言模型（VLM）的分布式训练效率远低于单模态大语言模型（LLM）。现有方案要么采用单体设计对异构模块分配统一并行策略，要么采用分离式部署但以批次同步流水线方式执行，这些方案仍然不够高效，VLM训练可以进一步解耦。

Method: 提出FlowTrain框架，将VLM训练重构为生产者-消费者数据流模型，通过统一内存池协调；引入全局虚拟地址空间使编码器和骨干网络独立推进；设计异构并行分配器，通过求解吞吐量匹配问题分配模块特定的并行策略；引入动态打包调度器，根据LLM端实际计算代价在运行时构建均衡微批次。

Result: 在真实工作负载上，FlowTrain实现了超过50%的模型浮点利用率（MFU）和最高1.7倍的吞吐量提升，缩小了与纯LLM训练之间的效率差距。

Conclusion: FlowTrain通过流式解耦训练框架有效提升了VLM分布式训练效率，验证了进一步解耦VLM训练的可行性和有效性。

Abstract: Industrial-grade distributed training of vision-language models (VLMs) remains far less efficient than that of unimodal LLMs. Existing solutions either follow a monolithic design that assigns uniform parallelism to heterogeneous modules or adopt a disaggregated deployment that separates modules while executing them as a batch-synchronized pipeline. In this paper, we highlight that the above solutions are still not sufficient, and VLM training can be further decoupled. To this end, we present FlowTrain, a flow-based decoupled training framework that reformulates VLM training as a producer-consumer dataflow coordinated through a unified memory pool. The encoder and backbone can progress independently over a global virtual address space. Since this execution decoupling fundamentally changes the optimization objective of allocation and scheduling, FlowTrain further introduces a heterogeneous parallel allocator that assigns module-specific parallelism strategies by solving a throughput matching problem. The dynamic packing scheduler is used to construct balanced microbatches at runtime according to the actual LLM-side computation cost. Extensive experiments on real-world workloads show that FlowTrain achieves over 50% MFU and up to 1.7x throughput improvement, narrowing the efficiency gap to LLM-only training.

</details>


### [247] [FLFL: Federated Latent Factor Learning for Private Recovery of Spatio-Temporal Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23091)
*Chengjun Yu,Di Wu,Yi He,Jia Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种联邦潜在因子学习（FLFL）模型，用于在保护数据隐私的前提下恢复无线传感器网络中缺失的时空信号。该模型通过传感器级联邦学习框架仅上传梯度信息而非原始数据，并结合时空相关性正则化提升恢复精度。在四个真实WSN数据集上的实验表明，FLFL在恢复精度和隐私保护方面显著优于八种现有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜在因子学习（LFL）模型需要将传感器采集的原始数据集中存储于中央服务器，这在数据所有者隐私意识日益增强的背景下变得不可接受。为解决WSNs中数据缺失恢复与隐私保护之间的矛盾，本文提出了隐私保护的联邦学习方案。

Method: 1) 设计基于LFL的传感器级联邦学习框架，各传感器只需上传梯度信息而非原始数据；2) 将时空相关性作为正则化约束融入联邦学习框架，以提高恢复精度。

Result: 在四个真实WSN数据集上的实验表明，FLFL在恢复精度和隐私保护方面显著优于八种最先进的联邦与非联邦信号恢复模型。

Conclusion: FLFL能够在不泄露原始数据的前提下，准确恢复WSNs中的缺失数据，有效平衡了数据恢复性能与隐私保护需求。

Abstract: Wireless sensor network (WSNs) stands out as a burgeoning and promising domain in intelligent sensing. Owing to various factors such as sudden sensor malfunctions or deliberate shutdown of partial nodes to save energy, the collected sensing signals from WSNs commonly have massive missing data, leading to adverse effects on subsequent analysis or decision-making. Latent factor learning (LFL) has proven to be highly effective in recovering the missing data for WSNs. However, the existing LFL models require the collected sensing signals to be maintained in one central place like a central server, which is becoming unacceptable for data owners who are getting increasingly privacy-sensitive. To address this issue, this paper innovatively proposes a federated latent factor learning (FLFL) model for privacy-preserving spatio-temporal signal recovery. Its main idea is two-fold: 1) it designs a sensor-level federated learning framework based on LFL, where each sensor only needs to upload gradient information rather than raw data for training a privacy-preserving recovery model, and 2) it incorporates the spatio-temporal correlation into the designed federated learning framework as the regularization constraint to improve its recovery accuracy. With such designs, FLFL can not only accurately recover the missing data of WSNs but also ensure data owners' privacy-preserving of raw data. To evaluate the proposed FLFL model, extensive experiments have been conducted on four real-world WSN datasets. The results demonstrate that FLFL significantly outperforms eight state-of-the-art federated and non-federated signal recovery models in terms of recovery accuracy with privacy-preserving.

</details>


### [248] [Minimax Quantile Lower Bounds for Interactive Statistical Decision Making with Privacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23096)
*Raghav Bongole,Amirreza Zamani,Tobias J. Oechtering,Mikael Skoglund*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对交互式统计决策制定（ISDM）中期望准则无法捕捉罕见但严重失败的问题，建立了δ-显式极小最大分位数理论，推导了高概率交互式Fano方法与Le Cam方法，并应用于高斯均值估计与多臂老虎机问题，得到了显式依赖于置信水平δ和隐私预算的下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统极小最大风险和遗憾准则基于期望，无法反映罕见但后果严重的失败事件，因此需要开发基于分位数的稳健决策理论来刻画高概率下的最坏情况表现。

Method: 建立了极小最大分位数、下极小最大分位数与极小最大风险之间的结构关系，推导了高概率交互式Fano方法和Le Cam方法作为逆工具，并通过限制可容许决策类将互信息隐私纳入同一框架，针对坐标高斯私有化提出双点模板来分离隐私引起的方差膨胀。

Result: 得到平方误差高斯均值估计的log(1/δ)/n缩放、两臂有界均值高斯老虎机的√(T log(1/δ))缩放、以及K臂老虎机的√(KT log(1/δ))类缩放，隐私问题中通过高斯方差膨胀因子体现。

Conclusion: 所建立的极小最大分位数理论能够统一处理交互式统计决策中的高概率保证与隐私约束，为隐私保护下的决策问题提供了显式的置信水平依赖下界。

Abstract: Minimax risk and regret are expectation-based criteria and do not capture rare but consequential failures. To address this concern, we develop a $δ$-explicit minimax-quantile theory for interactive statistical decision making (ISDM). We first provide structural relations between minimax quantiles, lower minimax quantiles, and minimax risk. This includes a quantile-to-expectation conversion and an equivalence between strict and lower minimax quantiles outside a countable set of confidence levels. We then derive two converse tools for ISDM: a high-probability interactive Fano's method and a high-probability interactive Le Cam's method. Then, we show that mutual-information (MI) privacy can be handled in the same framework by restricting the admissible decision class. For coordinatewise Gaussian privatization, we derive a two-point template that isolates the privacy-induced variance inflation. We instantiate this template for Gaussian mean estimation, and use the same two-point strategy directly for two-armed Gaussian bandits. We then derive a minimax quantile lower bound for the $K$-armed Gaussian bandit problem, showing that the interactive Fano method captures the exploration cost over multiple possible best arms. The resulting lower bounds are explicit in the confidence level $δ$ and in the privacy budget for the private problems. They yield $\log(1/δ)/n$ scaling for squared-error Gaussian mean estimation, $\sqrt{T\log(1/δ)}$ scaling for two-armed bounded-mean Gaussian bandits, and $\sqrt{KT\log(1/δ)}$-type scaling for the $K$-armed bandits, with privacy appearing through a Gaussian variance-inflation factor for the private problems.

</details>


### [249] [ReNIO: Reweighting Negative Trajectory Importance for LLM On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23104)
*Chen Lin,Kedi Chen,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ReNIO方法，通过学生-教师概率比率识别错误推理轨迹中的关键token并赋予更大权重，在不依赖最终答案正确性的情况下改进LLM同策略蒸馏，在数学推理和代码生成任务上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准同策略蒸馏（OPD）平等对待所有学生生成输出，忽略了不同输出蕴含的信息量差异。实验发现训练于错误输出比训练于正确输出效果更好，因为正确输出会导致更短的推理轨迹和较弱的反思行为，而错误输出能更好地保留模型能力边界附近的探索性推理。

Method: 提出ReNIO方法：利用学生-教师概率比率识别导致错误推理轨迹的关键token，聚合其信息为归一化样本权重，在不观察最终答案正确性的情况下，自然地为可能的负轨迹分配更大权重。该方法仅使用前缀条件化的token概率，保留了OPD的前缀训练优势。

Result: 在数学推理和代码生成任务上，ReNIO改进了OPD和OPSD，代表性相对增益：Qwen3-1.7B达8.90%，R1-Distill-Qwen-7B达10.00%。

Conclusion: ReNIO有效利用负轨迹信息提升蒸馏效果，无需完整答案rollout，保留前缀训练优势，是一种实用且高效的LLM推理增强方法。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves LLM reasoning by training a student model on its own generated outputs, but standard OPD treats all student-generated outputs (SGOs) equally regardless of their informativeness. We observe a consistent asymmetry in controlled filtering experiments: in both OPD and on-policy self distillation (OPSD), training only on incorrect SGOs outperforms training only on correct ones. Our further analysis suggests that models trained on correct-only SGOs tend to generate shorter reasoning traces and show weaker reflection behavior, while incorrect SGOs better preserve exploratory reasoning near the model's capability boundary. To exploit this signal without requiring full answer-containing rollouts, we introduce ReNIO, which Reweights Negative trajectory Importance for LLM On-policy distillation. By using the student-to-teacher probability ratio, ReNIO identifies pivotal tokens leading to wrong reasoning traces and aggregates their information into a normalized sample weight, inherently assigning larger weights to likely negative trajectories without observing the correctness of final-answer. Since Re-NIO only uses prefix-conditioned token probabilities, it preserves OPD's prefix training advantage over full-rollout reinforcement learning. Across both mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks, ReNIO improves both OPD and OPSD, with representative relative gains of up to 8.90% for Qwen3-1.7B and 10.00% for R1-Distill-Qwen-7B on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Code repo: https://github.com/BDML-lab/ReNIO.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

### [250] [On the Identifiability of User Adaptation in Co-Adaptive Neural Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20569)
*Philip Waggoner*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文分析了共适应人机系统中的可辨识性问题，指出闭环编码器估计无法唯一识别用户适应性，而是反映联合系统的属性，并讨论了识别条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在共适应人机系统中难以区分用户适应性变化与系统交互效应，导致对用户行为的解读存在偏差。

Method: 通过对闭环人机交互系统的理论分析，研究编码器估计的可辨识性，揭示其反映的是联合系统属性而非单一用户适应。

Result: 闭环编码器估计无法唯一确定用户适应性，而是体现人机联合系统的整体特性。

Conclusion: 提出了确保用户适应性可辨识的条件，为共适应系统的行为解释与实验设计提供了理论指导。

Abstract: We analyze identifiability in co-adaptive human-machine systems. We show that closed-loop encoder estimates do not uniquely identify user adaptation, but instead reflect properties of the joint system. We discuss implications for interpreting behavioral adaptation and propose conditions for identification.

</details>


### [251] [Beyond Fixed Budgets: Characterizing the Inelasticity and Limitations of Tree-of-Thought Reasoning Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20599)
*Atkia Mahila,Avinash Maurya,M. Mustafa Rafique,Bogdan Nicolae*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了两种树搜索方法（DPTS和SSDP）在不同计算预算、模型规模和问题难度下的表现，发现DPTS存在冷启动瓶颈（低预算时表现差），SSDP存在前沿耗尽问题（过早剪枝导致无法继续提升），并提出自适应搜索策略是未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 树搜索（Tree of Thought）方法在提升大语言模型推理能力方面显示出潜力，但不同搜索策略在不同计算预算、模型规模和问题难度下的行为差异尚未得到系统研究。

Method: 评估两种代表性方法：DPTS（基于蒙特卡洛树搜索）和SSDP（基于语义去重），在Math500和GSM8K两个数学推理基准上，使用Llama-3B和Llama-8B两种模型，以及4种token预算（3k-10k）进行实验。

Result: DPTS在低预算时因需要充分探索才能获得可靠估值而表现差（冷启动瓶颈），但在高预算下扩展性良好；SSDP能快速找到候选解，但因其激进的节点合并策略会永久丢弃未探索路径，导致无法进一步提升（前沿耗尽）。

Conclusion: 固定探索策略和固定剪枝策略均无法在不同计算资源条件下均表现良好，未来需要能够根据搜索进度和可用资源自适应调整行为的搜索策略。

Abstract: Tree of Thought (ToT) search has become a promising direction for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but deploying these methods in practice raises a question that has received little systematic attention: how do different search strategies behave under varying compute budgets, model sizes, and problem difficulties? In this work, we evaluate two representative ToT methods; DPTS, a Monte Carlo tree search based approach, and SSDP, a semantic deduplication based approach, across two mathematical reasoning benchmarks (Math500 and GSM8K), two model scales (Llama-3B and Llama-8B), and four token budgets (3k--10k). Our analysis reveals that the two methods exhibit limitations that pull in opposite directions. DPTS suffers from a cold-start bottleneck at low budgets: it requires sufficient exploration before its value estimates become reliable, making it a poor fit for resource-constrained settings despite strong scaling behavior at higher budgets. SSDP, on the other hand, reaches candidate solutions efficiently but is prone to frontier depletion; its aggressive node merging permanently discards unexplored paths, leaving it unable to improve regardless of how much budget remains. Together, these findings suggest that neither a fixed exploration strategy nor a fixed pruning strategy is sufficient across compute continuum. We argue that effective search for scientific reasoning agents requires strategies that can adapt their behavior based on search progress and available resources.

</details>


### [252] [The New Associationism: Lessons from Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20600)
*Daniel Rothschild*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 现代AI的成功表明，监督学习作为一种统一、渐进、错误驱动的学习机制，可以支持一种温和的联想主义学习理论，但需要借助远超传统联想主义设想的复杂计算架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨现代AI的成功对人类学习机制的理论启示，捍卫传统联想主义的合理内核，同时回应其局限性批评。

Method: 通过分析现代AI系统（如大语言模型和游戏智能体）中监督学习的普遍性，论证其作为统一学习机制的理论意义，并比较传统联想主义与深度学习架构的差异。

Result: 监督学习构成多种AI系统的核心机制，验证了联想主义关于跨领域统一、渐进、错误驱动学习的核心主张；但深度学习架构已远超传统联想主义的范畴。

Conclusion: 现代AI支持一种温和的联想主义——监督学习是重要组成部分而非学习的全部，需结合复杂计算架构才能解释人类认知。

Abstract: What can the success of modern AI tell us about how humans learn? This paper argues that taking AI seriously as a model of human learning supports a modest but genuine associationism. The central finding is that supervised learning -- learning driven by evaluative feedback -- underlies a surprisingly wide range of contemporary AI systems, from large language models to game-playing agents, differing primarily in how much work is required to generate the relevant feedback signal. This vindicates associationist ideals of a uniform, gradual, error-driven learning mechanism operating across domains, and defuses the once-influential argument that associationist mechanisms are too limited to account for human cognitive capacities. At the same time, the successes of deep learning depend on computational architectures that go well beyond anything classical associationists envisaged, and supervised learning operates within these as one component rather than a complete account of learning.

</details>


### [253] [Specifying AI-SDLC Processes: A Protocol Language for Human-Agent Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20615)
*Ylli Prifti*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于规范AI-SDLC（AI辅助软件开发生命周期）流程的领域特定语言（DSL），通过形式化语法、良构条件、操作语义和执行不变量来定义人机协作中的责任边界、审批门控和治理约束。该语言区分策略（声明意图）与机制（结构强制），并通过验证令牌和能力边界等原语约束过程非确定性。核心贡献包括：失效速率分析表明结构强制比行为合规更优；2+N团队模式形式化经典职责分离；克林闭包和自反性协议验证成为设计属性而非特例。已在多智能体框架（MetaGPT）、工作流规范（FlowAgent、BPMN扩展）和基于能力的安全（SAGA）的交叉点上定位其创新性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI代理参与软件开发生命周期时，缺乏一种专门的语言来表达人机之间的责任边界、审批门控和治理约束。现有方法要么将流程编码在提示中（易漂移），要么针对邻域（工作流管理、业务流程），要么只处理碎片化问题（访问控制、审批门控），无法满足AI-SDLC协作的完整需求。

Method: 提出一种领域特定语言（DSL），包含形式化语法、良构条件、操作语义和执行不变量。该语言核心设计为区分策略（policy，声明的意图）与机制（mechanism，结构强制），通过验证令牌（validation tokens）和能力边界（capability boundaries）等原语约束过程非确定性。同时提出2+N团队模式（两个人类控制角色+N个专业代理成员）来形式化职责分离。

Result: 三个主要结果：1）失效速率分析显示结构强制将系统失效率约束为代理与验证器速率的加权乘积，而行为合规则导致累积或近乎饱和增长；2）2+N团队模式形式化经典职责分离；3）克林闭包的编排循环和自反性协议验证成为设计属性而非特例。已有工作原型证明可行性。

Conclusion: 本文的贡献定位于多智能体框架（MetaGPT）、工作流规范（FlowAgent、BPMN扩展）和基于能力的安全（SAGA）的交汇处，创新点在于特定整合而非单一原语。实证评估为未来工作。

Abstract: AI agents now participate as first-class team members across the software development lifecycle, yet no specification language exists for expressing the human-agent responsibility boundaries, approval gates, and governance constraints this collaboration requires. Existing approaches encode process in agent prompts (subject to drift), target adjacent domains (workflow management, business processes), or address only fragments (access control, approval gates).
  We propose a domain-specific language for specifying AI-SDLC processes as protocols, with formal syntax, well-formedness conditions, operational semantics, and enforcement invariants. The language distinguishes policy (declared intent) from mechanism (structural enforcement), enabling implementations to bound process non-determinism through primitives such as validation tokens and capability boundaries.
  Three results follow. A failure rate analysis shows that structural enforcement bounds system failure rates at a weighted product of agent and validator rates, while behavioral compliance permits cumulative or near-saturating growth. The 2+N team pattern (two human-in-control roles plus N specialized agent members) formalizes classical Separation of Duties for AI-SDLC. Kleene closure of orchestration loops and reflexive protocol-adherence validation emerge as design properties rather than special-case constructs.
  We position the contribution against multi-agent frameworks (MetaGPT), workflow specification (FlowAgent, BPMN extensions), and capability-based security (SAGA): the novelty lies in the specific integration, not any single primitive. A working implementation demonstrates feasibility; empirical evaluation is future work.

</details>


### [254] [PEAR: Permutation-Equivariant Adaptive Routing Multi-Agent Debate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20621)
*Yang Feng,Ziwei Xu,Xia Hu,Fengxiang He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PEAR是一种基于排列等变自适应路由的多智能体辩论协议，通过动态重新配置智能体的通信角色和稀疏拓扑结构，避免固定拓扑带来的位置偏见和角色敏感性问题，在四个推理基准和六个LLM骨干网络上显著提升了平均准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多智能体辩论方法使用固定拓扑结构，导致持续的positional bias、不可靠智能体的影响力放大以及对角色分配的高度敏感性问题，需要一种能够动态调整通信结构的方案来提升辩论的可靠性和公平性。

Method: 提出排列等变自适应路由多智能体辩论协议（PEAR），在连续辩论轮次中动态重新配置通信角色和稀疏拓扑结构，基于智能体状态变化策略性地切换智能体与角色的分配，防止任何智能体永久占据特权网络位置。

Result: 在四个推理基准和六个多样化LLM骨干网络上进行综合实验，PEAR在平均准确率上显著超过了最强的辩论基线方法。

Conclusion: PEAR理论上被刻画为等变稀疏路由器，在保持智能体重标记下准确性的同时降低了路由复杂度并提升了泛化能力，有效解决了固定拓扑多智能体辩论中的关键缺陷。

Abstract: Multi-agent debate improves the reliability of large language models (LLMs) through iterative peer critiques. However, fixed topologies often introduce persistent positional biases, amplify unreliable agents, and cause high sensitivity to role assignments. We introduce \textit{Permutation-Equivariant Adaptive Routing Multi-Agent Debate (PEAR)}, an inference-time protocol that dynamically reconfigures communication roles and sparse topologies across consecutive debate rounds. By strategically switching agent-to-role assignments based on evolving agent states, PEAR prevents any agent from permanently occupying a privileged network position or distributes influence more evenly across the debate. We theoretically characterize PEAR as an equivariant sparse router: it preserves accuracy under agent relabeling while reducing routing complexity and improving generalization. Comprehensive empirical evaluations across four reasoning benchmarks and six diverse LLM backbones demonstrate PEAR significantly improves average accuracy over the strongest debate baselines. The code is at https://github.com/EVIEHub/PEAR.

</details>


### [255] [Darwin Mobile Agent: A Roadmap for Self-Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20622)
*Daniel Beechey,Derek Yuen,Jianheng Liu,Dezhao Luo,Tiantian He,Weilin Luo,Jun Wang,Kun Shao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出通过消除人类先验知识、利用移动图形用户界面(GUI)作为复杂环境的代理，并构建Darwin Mobile Agent开源基础设施，实现自主强化学习的自演化智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 创造能够在开放环境中展现通用、自适应行为的智能体是AI的最终目标。当前方法过度依赖人类先验知识，限制了智能体的自主演化能力。

Method: 提出移动GUI作为"大世界"代理，构建Darwin Mobile Agent基础设施，采用异步智能体-环境循环跨并行云手机实例进行数据收集，并从任务课程、结果验证和记忆管理三个支柱系统性移除人类先验。

Result: 验证了Darwin基础设施在GUI领域的策略优化阶段具备所需的稳定性和可扩展性。

Conclusion: 该工作为迈向真正自主、自演化的GUI智能体奠定了实践和理论基础。

Abstract: The goal of artificial intelligence is to create agents capable of general, adaptive behaviour in open-ended environments. Guided by the "Bitter Lesson", we argue that the most effective path toward this goal is to systematically remove human priors and allow intelligence to naturally emerge through interaction with a "Big World" that is orders of magnitude more complex than the agent itself. We propose the mobile Graphical User Interface (GUI) as a practical proxy for such a world and introduce Darwin Mobile Agent, an open-source infrastructure designed as a foundation for autonomous reinforcement learning in this domain. This framework addresses the data-collection bottleneck in real-world mobile interactions by using an asynchronous agent-environment loop across parallel cloud-phone instances. We further propose a conceptual roadmap to systematically remove human priors from three fundamental pillars of a self-evolving agent: task curricula, outcome verification, and memory management. We validate that the Darwin infrastructure provides the stability and scalability required for the first stage of this roadmap: policy optimisation in the GUI domain. This work establishes the practical and theoretical foundation necessary to move toward truly autonomous, self-evolving GUI agents.

</details>


### [256] [Path-dependent program induction under resource constraints explains human sequence learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20623)
*Hanqi Zhou,David G. Nagy,Peter Dayan,Charley M. Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文整合率失真理论与程序归纳，提出分层适应语法（HAG）模型，在有限认知资源下解释人如何从序列经验中构建抽象可重用知识。模拟显示HAG在率失真权衡与泛化上优于固定语法和浅层组块方法；在线旋律序列学习实验中，参与者的回忆错误和反应时模式支持了层次化抽象结构的存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 回答人们在有限认知资源下如何从序列经验中构建抽象、可重用知识的核心问题。

Method: 整合率失真理论与程序归纳，提出分层适应语法（HAG）模型，包含局部（任务内）和全局（跨任务）两个层面的抽象库，受记忆与计算约束共同调控。

Result: 模拟中HAG在率失真权衡和泛化能力上优于固定语法和浅层组块方法；在线旋律序列学习实验中，参与者的回忆错误呈现系统性简化，反应时在推断的程序边界处增加；逐试次拟合表明层次化抽象库最优地解释了回忆和延续选择的个体差异。

Conclusion: 结构化学习可视为受约束的程序归纳过程，其中经验顺序塑造了学习者未来构建的抽象结构。

Abstract: How do people build abstract, reusable knowledge from sequential experience under bounded cognitive resources? To answer this question, we integrate rate-distortion theory with recent advances in program induction to describe how prior knowledge shapes which future structures are cheap to encode and easy to discover. We formalize this in a hierarchical Adaptor Grammar (HAG) with distinct local (within-task) and global (across-task) libraries, governed jointly by constraints on memory and computation. In simulations, HAG achieves better rate-distortion trade-offs and stronger generalization than fixed grammars or shallow chunking methods. In an online melodic sequence-learning experiment, participants' recall errors reflected systematic simplifications and reaction times increased at inferred program boundaries. Trial-by-trial fits further showed that hierarchical libraries best explained individual differences in both recall and out-of-sample continuation choices, outperforming all alternative models. These findings cast structured learning as bounded program induction in which the order of experience shapes future abstractions a learner builds.

</details>


### [257] [In LLM Reasoning, there is Irrationality on top of Value Misalignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20624)
*Kejiang Qian,Fengxiang He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出并形式化了“理性价值风险”（Rational Value Risk）概念，指即使LLM在训练中良好对齐，推理时仍可能无法最大化对齐价值。通过分解估计误差及大量实验（覆盖多个模型家族和基准），验证了该风险普遍存在、价值对齐可缓解但无法消除、对推理策略高度敏感，且长链推理效果递减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有的LLM对齐研究主要关注训练阶段，但即使模型在训练后已良好对齐，推理时仍可能偏离最优价值最大化策略。作者希望揭示并形式化这一“对齐-推理”之间的价值偏差，从而更全面地理解LLM的理性行为。

Method: 首先数学形式化定义理性价值风险为模型部署的推理策略与理性策略（在最陡方向最大化期望效用的响应）之间的效用差异。进一步将估计误差分解为三个来源：有限候选、有限提示和不完美验证器。在Llama-3.1、Qwen-2.5、Tülu-3（7B-72B）、GPT-5.2、GPT-5.5、DeepSeek-V4等模型及UltraFeedback、AlpacaEval、GSM8K、MATH、HumanEval、MathArena等基准上进行实验验证。

Result: (1) 理性价值风险普遍存在；(2) 价值对齐可以降低但不能消除该风险；(3) 该风险对推理时的推理策略高度敏感；(4) 更长的推理链能提升理性但存在边际递减效应。

Conclusion: LLM的对齐不应止步于训练阶段，推理策略本身对理性价值最大化有显著影响。这为未来在推理层面进一步优化LLM的理性行为提供了理论和实验基础。

Abstract: Significant progress has been made in aligning LLMs with target value functions. We argue that, even when an LLM has been well aligned in (post-)training, it may still fail to maximise the aligned value in reasoning. We mathematically formalise this gap as rational value risk: the utility discrepancy between a model's deployed reasoning strategy and its rational counterpart, which is defined to be the responses that maximise expected utility in the steepest direction. The estimation error of rational value risk is further decomposed into three components from finite candidates, finite prompts, and imperfect verifiers. Extensive experiments are conducted, covering models Llama-3.1, Qwen-2.5, T{\"}ulu-3 families (7B-72B), GPT-5.2, GPT-5.5, and DeepSeek-V4, and benchmarks UltraFeedback, AlpacaEval, GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, and MathArena. The results validate that (1) rational value risk is widespread; (2) value alignment can reduce, but cannot eliminate, it; (3) the risk is highly sensitive to inference-time reasoning strategy; and (4) longer reasoning improves rationality with diminishing returns. The code is at https://github.com/EVIEHub/LLM-Rationality.

</details>


### [258] [AlphaMemo: Structured Search-Process Memory for Self-Evolving Alpha Mining Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20625)
*Hang Yu,Zifan Zheng,Jeff Z. Pan,Tongliang Liu,Zhiyong Wang,Fengxiang He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AlphaMemo提出了一种基于结构化搜索过程记忆的自演化因子挖掘智能体，通过AST差异提取编辑模式、置信门控残差记忆和不对称否决控制，在CSI 500和S&P 500数据集上实现了更好的样本外表现和固定预算下的发现效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体在因子挖掘中面临组合搜索空间大、噪声非平稳反馈、冗余发现以及过度拟合等问题，简单复用过去成功经验容易导致过拟合。

Method: 1) 从AST差异中提取编辑模式(motifs)；2) 在搜索账本先验基础上构建置信门控残差记忆；3) 使用不对称否决控制抑制高置信度的失败模式。

Result: 在CSI 500和S&P 500数据集上，样本外表现和固定预算下的发现效率均有提升；消融实验验证了残差学习、置信门控、AST差异模式和否决记忆各自的有效性。

Conclusion: 结构化搜索过程记忆比简单记忆最终因子或完整轨迹更有效，置信门控残差记忆和不对称否决控制相结合可以缓解因子挖掘中的过拟合和冗余发现问题。

Abstract: LLM agents are promising for alpha mining via combining financial priors, symbolic reasoning, executable factor generation, and feedback-driven refinement. Yet, they face a combinatorial search space, noisy non-stationary feedback, redundant discoveries, and overfitting risks from naively reusing past successes. To address these challenges, we propose AlphaMemo, a self-evolving alpha mining agent with Structured Search-Process Memory. Rather than memorizing only final factors or full trajectories, AlphaMemo records reusable evidence about which edit motifs work or fail under specific parent-factor contexts. It extracts motifs from Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) differences, applies confidence-gated residual memory on top of a search-ledger prior, and uses asymmetric veto control to suppress high-confidence failure patterns. Experiments on CSI 500 and S\&P 500 show improved out-of-sample performance and fixed-budget discovery efficiency, with ablations validating the roles of residual learning, confidence gating, AST-diff motifs, and veto memory. Code is at https://github.com/jarrettyu/AlphaMemo.

</details>


### [259] [Latent Goal Prediction from Language for Model-Based Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20627)
*Samuel Barbeau,Simon Roy,Giovanni Beltrame,Christian Desrosiers,Nicolas Thome*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LAGO是一个从语言指令预测潜在子目标序列并在同一潜在空间进行规划的新框架，通过动态分解指令为可处理的局部子目标，结合软最小轨迹成本，实现了长程、鲁棒且精确的规划，克服了传统世界模型中的复合预测误差和多模态对齐问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于世界模型的规划方法面临两大瓶颈：复合预测误差累积导致长程规划失效，以及视觉目标提供精确局部梯度但缺乏远距离指导，语言虽灵活但受限于跨模态对齐噪声或依赖不适合高采样规划的大型生成模型。

Method: 提出LAGO框架，在统一潜在空间中同时预测语言指令对应的中间目标状态序列（潜在子目标）和基于动作的 rollout；通过动态在线更新子目标，并在规划时采用软最小轨迹成本（soft minimum trajectory cost）进行优化。

Result: 在多种环境和规划视野上的评估表明，LAGO避免了先前方法的急剧性能下降，实现了稳健且精确的长程规划。

Conclusion: LAGO成功桥接了视觉目标的精确性与语言引导的灵活性，实现仅从语言指令出发的鲁棒长程规划。

Abstract: Planning with world models is bottlenecked by compounding prediction errors and the difficulty of defining optimizable goals. Visual targets provide precise local gradients but poor distant guidance, while language is flexible yet limited by noisy cross-modal alignment or dependence on large generative models unsuited for the high-sampling nature of model-based planning. To address these challenges, we introduce Latent Goal Prediction from Language (LAGO), a framework that predicts both sequences of intermediate goal states from language instructions and action-conditioned rollouts, all within the same latent space. Rather than optimizing toward a single global objective, LAGO dynamically decomposes instructions into explicitly predicted, locally tractable latent subgoals. By updating these subgoals online and using a soft minimum trajectory cost during planning, LAGO enables an agent to follow coherent latent trajectories over long horizons. Evaluation across multiple environments planning horizons shows that LAGO avoids the sharp degradation of prior methods. By achieving robust and precise long-horizon planning purely from language, LAGO bridges the precision of visual goals with the flexibility of text-guided control.

</details>


### [260] [Human Decision-Making with AI Assistance under Correlated Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20628)
*Yanru Guan,Naveen Raman,Fei Fang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了AI辅助决策中，当特征存在相关性时，如何平衡短期决策质量与人类长期学习的问题。证明特征相关导致固定策略性能极差，最优策略需遵循"先探索后承诺"的结构，并提出了基于动态规划的最优算法和近似方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在AI辅助决策场景中（如医生遵循AI推荐的诊断测试），不同特征（测试结果）间存在相关性。需要研究AI应推荐哪些测试，以平衡短期决策质量和长期人类学习效果。

Method: 首先理论证明特征相关时固定策略表现极差，并证明最优策略必须遵循"探索-承诺"结构（先提供多样化测试让人类学习准确特征系数，后固定测试集）。证明求解最优策略是NP-hard的，提出基于动态规划的有限时域最优算法，以及通过缩短规划时域并附加固定后缀的近似方法。

Result: 理论证明了特征相关性导致固定策略任意差；最优策略具有探索-承诺结构，探索长度取决于特征相关程度；计算最优策略是NP-hard的；所提动态规划算法和近似方法能实现近最优性能；实验证实更强的特征相关导致更长的探索阶段。

Conclusion: 特征相关性在AI辅助决策中至关重要，最优策略需要主动探索以促进人类学习，而非简单重复推荐相同测试。

Abstract: Humans increasingly make decisions with AI assistance; for example, doctors may follow AI-recommended diagnostic tests and base their diagnoses on the results. A natural question is which tests should AI recommend to balance short-term decision quality and long-term human learning when different features (e.g., test results) are correlated. While prior work establishes that stationary policies that recommend the same tests repeatedly are optimal when features are independent, we prove that feature correlations lead such policies to perform arbitrarily poorly. Instead, we prove that any optimal policy must follow an explore-then-commit structure; initially, the AI should offer diverse tests so humans can learn accurate feature coefficients, then the AI should commit to a single set of tests, with exploration length that depends on the degree of feature correlation. We prove that computing the optimal policy is NP-hard and derive a dynamic programming-based algorithm that finds the optimal policy for finite horizons. We additionally develop an approximation that plans for shorter horizons and appends a stationary suffix, achieving near-optimal performance. Our empirical results complement our theory by showing that stronger feature correlation leads to longer exploration phases.

</details>


### [261] [Harnessing Agent Skills: Architectural Patterns and a Reference Architecture for Skill-Mediated LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20631)
*Boming Xia,Liming Zhu,Zhenchang Xing,Qinghua Lu,Dino Sejdinovic,Xiwei Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了智能体技能利用（skill harnessing）的架构职责，提出了10种经验性架构模式（5种核心+5种辅助），并将其综合为包含四个责任层（供应链、中介、执行控制、证据与反馈）的参考架构，通过8个系统进行了跨实例评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体技能（agent skills）作为可复用的面向智能体的行为知识与指导，其静态工件（skill artefact）在运行时需要通过选择、绑定、解释和记录等过程转化为技能使用态（skill-in-use），但这一转化过程的架构职责尚未被系统化研究。

Method: 基于经验性研究，归纳出10种架构模式（5种核心模式+5种辅助模式），并将其综合为四层参考架构（供应链层、中介层、执行控制层、证据与反馈层），最后通过对8个选定系统的跨实例化评估来验证该架构。

Result: 提出了技能利用（skill harnessing）的参考架构，包含四个责任层，并通过8个系统的跨实例化评估验证了该架构的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的模式与参考架构为分析智能体系统中的技能利用职责提供了统一的词汇表和诊断框架。

Abstract: Agent skills externalise reusable agent-facing behavioural knowledge and guidance as persistent artefacts that can be discovered, activated, and interpreted by LLM agents. Although a skill artefact is static at rest, its architectural responsibilities arise in use, when the artefact is selected for a run, bound to context and authority constraints, interpreted by a stochastic agent, and recorded as run evidence. We call this run-specific relation skill-in-use. This paper studies agent skill harnessing: the architectural responsibilities that govern the transition from skill artefacts to skill-in-use, bound the executable consequences associated with skill-in-use, and capture evidence for attribution, verification, repair, and evolution. This paper provides a catalogue of ten empirically grounded architectural patterns (five core, five supporting) for skill harnessing and synthesises them into a reference architecture with four responsibility layers: Supply Chain, Mediation, Execution Control, and Evidence & Feedback. We evaluate the architecture through cross-instantiation across 8 selected systems. The resulting patterns and reference architecture provide a vocabulary and diagnostic frame for analysing skill-harnessing responsibilities across agent systems.

</details>


### [262] [DEMM-Bench: A Cross-Regime Benchmark for Agent-Runtime Governance-Evidence Sufficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20634)
*Oleg Solozobov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DEMM-Bench是一个跨机制的智能体运行时治理证据充分性基准，基于决策证据成熟度模型(DEMM)，通过64个手稿案例评估8种证据机制能否充分重建决策级属性，发现trace-present和schema-present基线在75%案例上夸大声称，而经过属性级候选评分器可实现零夸大声称和56.25%的平均属性充分性准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体运行时系统会产生多种记录（追踪、账本、溯源图、策略日志、委托令牌、缓存事件、工具防火墙记录），但这些容器不一定能回答关于特定决策的治理问题。缺少一个统一的基准来衡量这些异构证据机制是否足以重建决策级属性。

Method: 基于决策证据成熟度模型(DEMM)，通过适配器标准化8种证据机制，提出属性级问题（行为者、权威、行动、策略、决策依据、资源接触、生命周期上下文、验证强度），并应用8种确定性退化条件。在64个手稿案例上评估trace-present、schema-present、ledger-present基线以及属性级候选评分器。

Result: trace-present和schema-present基线在75%案例上夸大声称，ledger-present在50%案例上夸大声称；属性级候选评分器实现零夸大声称，平均属性充分性准确率为56.25%。

Conclusion: 该基准提供了64案例数据集、构建-预言标签、基线和适配器，支持在异构智能体运行时证据基板上进行可重复的决策证据成熟度评估。

Abstract: Agent-runtime systems emit traces, ledgers, provenance graphs, policy logs, delegation tokens, cache events, and tool-firewall records, but those containers do not necessarily answer governance questions about a specific decision. DEMM-Bench is a cross-regime benchmark for agent-runtime governance-evidence sufficiency, grounded in the Decision Evidence Maturity Model (DEMM): it measures whether records across eight evidence regimes are sufficient to reconstruct decision-level properties rather than merely present. The benchmark normalizes the regimes through adapters, asks property questions over actor, authority, action, policy, decision basis, resource touch, lifecycle context, and verification strength, and applies eight deterministic degradation conditions. Across 64 manuscript cases, trace-present and schema-present baselines overclaim on 75% of cases, ledger-present overclaims on 50%, and the redacted property-level candidate scorer has zero overclaim with 56.25% mean Property Sufficiency Accuracy. The deposited package provides the 64-case dataset, construction-oracle labels, baselines, and adapters, supporting reproducible evaluation of decision-evidence maturity across heterogeneous agent-runtime evidence substrates.

</details>


### [263] [SkillHarness: Harnessing Safe Skills for Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20636)
*Yurun Chen,Biao Yi,Keting Yin,Shengyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了SkillHarness框架，通过安全约束的交互过程建模技能学习与利用，引入技能边界和选择性技能重用，在动态环境中显著降低不安全率57.1%并提升执行稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CUA技能学习方法假设静态安全环境，忽视了对抗性交互（如提示注入）和环境动态变化（如弹窗）带来的风险，导致在动态环境中学习到危险技能且执行脆弱。

Method: SkillHarness框架：(1) 技能边界——利用多源监督信号从交互轨迹中识别安全技能；(2) 自我改进的安全约束——在技能生命周期中构建持续优化的安全约束；(3) 选择性技能重用——根据上下文分解任务并选择性激活技能子集完成。

Result: 将学习技能的不安全率降低57.1%，在动态环境变化下持续提升执行稳定性，优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过将安全约束纳入技能学习与利用的全过程，实现了CUA在动态环境中安全可靠地持续学习与复用技能。

Abstract: Computer-Use Agents (CUAs) are increasingly deployed in dynamic interactive environments, creating a growing need for continual skill learning during interaction. Recent approaches address this challenge by learning reusable skills from successful trajectories. However, these skill learning methods largely assume static and safe environments, overlooking risks from adversarial interactions (e.g., prompt injections) and environmental dynamics (e.g., pop-ups). In dynamic settings, such assumptions can lead to risky skill learning and brittle execution, undermining the reliability of CUAs. This raises the question: how can CUAs learn and use skills safely in dynamic environments? To address this problem, we propose SkillHarness, a framework for safe skill harnessing in dynamic environments. SkillHarness moves beyond static skill abstractions by modeling skill learning and utilization as a safety-constrained interaction process. Specifically, we introduce the skill boundary that leverages multi-source supervision signals to identify safe skills from interaction trajectories, and construct self-improving safety constraints throughout the skill lifecycle. In addition, SkillHarness introduces selective skill reuse, where tasks are guided to decompose according to context and completed through the selective activation of skill subsets. Our experiments demonstrate that SkillHarness significantly reduces the unsafe rate of learned skills by 57.1% and consistently improves execution stability under dynamic environmental changes, outperforming existing baselines.

</details>


### [264] [Constituency Optimisation Through Hamiltonian Representation Of Mandates (COTHROM): Algorithmic Redistricting of Irish Election Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20637)
*Ruaidhrí Campion,Matthew Fenlon,Joshua Cooney Mercedal,Casey Farren-Colloty,Eliza Somerville,Michael A. J. Mitchell*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个针对爱尔兰PR-STV选举系统的计算重划选区框架，将宪法目标建模为Potts哈密顿量中的项，通过MCMC和模拟退火优化，并利用MCDA和帕累托最优性处理目标权重选择问题。在科克郡的实验中，COTTHROM方法在比例代表性和紧凑性目标上持续优于现有法律选区边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 爱尔兰PR-STV选举系统中的选区重划面临巨大配置空间下寻找最优代表性问题，且"代表性"需要在多个常相互冲突的宪法目标间取得微妙平衡，现有方法缺乏系统性优化。

Method: 将选举重划问题解析为统计物理学框架，宪法目标作为Potts哈密顿量中的项；采用MCMC和模拟退火最小化目标函数，以耦合常数作为目标权重的代理；运用MCDA和帕累托最优性解决目标权重组合的模糊性问题。

Result: 在科克郡的实际测试中，COTTHROM框架在比例代表性和紧凑性评估指标上，针对多种目标权重组合均持续优于现有的法定选区边界。

Conclusion: 基于统计物理和MCDA的计算框架能够有效优化爱尔兰PR-STV系统的选区重划问题，使权衡过程显式化、可量化，并产生优于现行方案的选区划分结果。

Abstract: Electoral redistricting in Ireland's Proportional Representation Single Transferable Vote (PR-STV) system faces the challenge of selecting an optimally representative set of electoral boundaries from an enormous set of possible configurations, and where ``representative'' is a delicate balance of constitutional objectives that are often in tension with one another. We present the first computational framework for Irish electoral redistricting that systematically optimises across multiple constitutional requirements while making trade-offs explicit and quantifiable. The electoral redistricting problem is parsed using statistical physics, where constitutional objectives are considered as terms in a Potts Hamiltonian. Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods and simulated annealing are employed to minimise this objective function, systematically exploring this configuration space, with coupling constants as proxies for objective weightings. Multi Criterion Decision Analysis (MCDA) and Pareto Optimality is then utilised to remedy the ambiguity in choosing a certain objective weighting combination over others. With respect to proportional representation and compactness objectives evaluated in County Cork, COTHROM consistently improves on the existing legal constituency boundaries for a range of objective weightings.

</details>


### [265] [RIZZ: Routing Interactions to Near Zero-Interference Zones for Continual Adaptation of Black-Box Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20638)
*Sonali Goel,Pranav Vaidhyanathan,Lucas Schorling,Natalia Ares,Maike Osborne*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RIZZ是一种面向复合语言模型系统的持续适应框架，通过验证器门控的记忆、路由和提示编译机制，在黑盒条件下实现在线适应，有效控制任务间干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有黑盒适应方法（单提示优化、无区分记忆、重复搜索）在处理非平稳输入流、稀疏反馈以及跨任务族污染时表现不佳，亟需一种能够在线适应且显式控制干扰的框架。

Method: RIZZ框架包含三个核心组件：1) 动态生成记忆分支组织输入流；2) 上下文感知路由器在线或离线选择/创建分支，并检索分支本地、全局、图结构和工作记忆上下文，编译为有界提示；3) 任务验证器仅允许通过验证的交互更新记忆、推广/降级规则或创建反模式。

Result: 在竞争性基准测试中，RIZZ框架优于现有的最先进基线方法。

Conclusion: RIZZ证明了通过验证器门控的记忆、路由和提示编译，可以在不访问模型权重的情况下实现持续学习，并显式控制任务间干扰，适用于上下文预算约束下的在线适应场景。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as long-lived agents that must adapt across users, tasks, domains, modalities, and feedback regimes without access to model weights. Existing black-box adaptation methods typically optimize a single prompt, maintain an undifferentiated memory, or rely on repeated rollout-heavy search. However, these designs struggle when streams of input are nonstationary, feedback is sparse, and failures from one task family can contaminate behavior on another. We introduce RIZZ (Routing Interactions to Near Zero-interference Zones), a continual adaptation framework for compound language-model systems that learns entirely through verifier-gated memory, routing, and prompt compilation. RIZZ organizes input streams into dynamically spawned memory branches. At inference time, either while online or offline, a context-aware router selects or creates a branch that retrieves branch-local, global, graph-structured, and working-memory context, which is compiled into a bounded prompt together with retrieved task evidence. After the model acts, task verifiers score the output, and only verified interactions can update memory, promote reusable rules, demote harmful rules, or create anti-patterns. This yields a black-box agent that improves through persistent natural-language feedback while explicitly controlling interference. RIZZ targets the regime where adaptation must occur online under context budgets. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework against state-of-the-art baselines on competitive benchmarks.

</details>


### [266] [An LLM-Explainable DRL Framework for Passenger-Directed Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20640)
*Ouided Braoui,Meriem Bouali,Nadir Farhi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将深度强化学习（DRL）与大型语言模型（LLM）可解释性模块相结合，用于自动驾驶决策。DRL代理使用Dueling Double Deep Q-Network训练，可执行"快速"、"舒适"和"停止"三种驾驶模式，并在模拟中展示了稳定学习、安全合规和模式切换能力。LLM模块负责解释乘客请求、判断何时需要解释并生成安全导向的简洁说明。实验表明，该框架在平衡安全性、适应性和可解释性方面有效，尤其在请求因安全约束被延迟或覆盖时效果最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶车辆虽然具有提升交通安全和效率的潜力，但其决策过程缺乏透明度，导致公众信任度有限。因此，需要一种能够解释自动驾驶行为、增强乘客信任的可解释性框架。

Method: 1) 使用Dueling Double Deep Q-Network训练DRL代理，支持快速、舒适和停止三种驾驶模式；2) 引入LLM模块处理乘客请求、判断解释时机并生成安全导向的解释文本；3) 在模拟环境中验证模型的稳定学习、交通规则遵守和模式切换能力。

Result: DRL代理展示了稳定学习、安全合规以及单次行程内可靠的模式切换能力。LLM模块能有效解释乘客请求并生成安全导向的说明。整个框架在平衡安全、适应性和可解释性方面表现良好，尤其在请求因安全约束被延迟或覆盖时效果最为显著。

Conclusion: 该工作作为将强化学习决策与LLM可解释性相结合的概念验证，证明了整合DRL和LLM可以有效提升自动驾驶的透明度和乘客信任度，未来有望在实际自动驾驶场景中推广应用。

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles offer the potential for safer and more efficient mobility, yet public trust remains limited due to the lack of transparency in their decision-making. This work addresses this issue by combining deep reinforcement learning (DRL) for adaptive driving control with large language model (LLM)-based explainability modules designed to communicate agent behavior to passengers. DRL agents were trained in simulation using a Dueling Double Deep Q-Network to follow distinct driving requests: \textit{fast}, \textit{comfort}, and \textit{stop}. They demonstrated stable learning, safe compliance with traffic rules, and reliable switching between modes within a single trip. In parallel, LLM modules were introduced to interpret passenger requests, determine when explanations were needed, and generate concise, safety-oriented justifications. Results show that this framework, serving as a proof of concept for integrating RL decision-making and LLMs, balances safety, adaptability, and explainability, and is most effective when requests are delayed or overridden due to safety constraints.

</details>


### [267] [PulseCX: Breaking the Closed-World Assumption in Real-Time CX](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21124)
*Rajat Agarwal,Suvidha Tripathi,Shubham Sharma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PulseCX是一个解耦知识获取与消费的框架，通过异步代理将信号线性化为衰减感知时序知识图谱（DA-TKG），结合强化-衰减动力学管理信息生命周期，并利用分层意图门控消除同步搜索瓶颈，在动态环境下显著提升意图解析率和客户满意度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话式AI客服受限于封闭世界约束，无法感知高速变化的外部信息（如病毒式传播趋势或服务中断），而临时性的网络搜索会引入过高的延迟和上下文污染。

Method: 采用结构优先范式，通过异步代理将信号线性化为衰减感知时序知识图谱（DA-TKG），利用强化-衰减动力学主动管理信息生命周期，并耦合分层意图门控实现知识获取与消费的解耦。

Result: 在动态环境下，PulseCX将同步搜索开销降至<10ms，并显著提升了意图解析率（IRR）和客户满意度（s-CSAT）。

Conclusion: 解耦知识获取与消费的结构优先方法，结合时序衰减机制和分层意图门控，能有效解决对话AI在动态环境下的实时知识更新问题，同时避免传统搜索带来的延迟和上下文污染。
