However, the lack of formal specification language corpora in the wild often makes LLMs fail to generate syntactically correct and semantically verifiable specifications. To mitigate this gap, we propose KBSpec, which augments LLMs with dual-source knowledge of formal specification language: external knowledge from official documentation, and internal knowledge distilled from verifier feedback on LLM-generated specifications. KBSpec maintains a self-evolving knowledge base that is continuously updated from successful generation and repair trajectories, without any LLM parameter tuning or labeled training data. We evaluate KBSpec on Java Modeling Language (JML) specification generation with three LLM backends, and results show that KBSpec improves verification pass rates by 10-25% over state-of-the-art LLM-based approaches, while producing the largest number of high-completeness specifications.

</details>


### [442] [ATLAS: Agentic Taxonomy of Large-Scale Software Ecosystems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21597)
*Junyi Lu,Mengyao Lyu,Jiahui Wu,Lei Yu,Chengwei Liu,Fengjun Zhang,Li Yang,Chun Zuo,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: ATLAS是首个自动为GitHub软件仓库构建分层分类法并完成端到端分类的框架，通过LLM全局知识与真实仓库分布相结合，在54,387个仓库上Taxonomy Quality F-score达83.13%，优于最优基线15个百分点，在下游任务中替代发现P@1达85.71%，超越人工策展列表。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GitHub开源生态系统缺乏系统化的分层分类法，现有GitHub Topics机制是扁平的、不一致的，且仅覆盖67%的项目，亟需一种能够自动构建层次化分类体系的方法。

Method: 结合LLM全局知识与真实仓库分布，通过Designer Agent提出分裂维度，Classifier Agent分配仓库，并采用自我纠正的迭代精炼循环，利用分类失败驱动维度修正（通过逐步升级策略），自动构建分层分类法并分类项目。

Result: 在54,387个GitHub仓库上，ATLAS在分层2,001仓库基准上TQF达83.13%，优于最优基线15个百分点；全54k语料上近似TQF为73.0%；下游任务中替代发现P@1=85.71%，超越人工策展列表（62.34%）；仓库检索P@1最高；揭示AI/ML应用占新社区采纳项目的61%的生态系统趋势。

Conclusion: ATLAS是唯一能同时实现高结构质量与高实际适用性的方法，其层次化分类法能够揭示扁平标签或相似性方法难以获得的生态系统结构性趋势。

Abstract: The open-source ecosystem on GitHub lacks a systematic hierarchical taxonomy of software repositories. GitHub Topics, the dominant organizational mechanism, is flat, inconsistent, and covers only 67% of projects. We present ATLAS, the first framework that automatically constructs a hierarchical taxonomy for software repositories and classifies projects into it end-to-end. By combining LLM global knowledge with real repository distributions, ATLAS proposes meaningful splitting dimensions and iteratively corrects those that fail to accommodate real projects. A Designer Agent proposes splitting dimensions while a Classifier Agent assigns repositories; a self-corrective refinement loop uses classification failures to drive dimension revision through escalating strategies. We evaluate ATLAS on 54,387 GitHub repositories against six baselines spanning four paradigms, two downstream tasks, and three model families. On a stratified 2,001-repository benchmark, ATLAS achieves a Taxonomy Quality F-score (TQF) of 83.13%, outperforming the best baseline by 15 percentage points (on the full 54k corpus the approximate TQF is 73.0%, a gap driven by Path Granularity's all-or-nothing scoring on longer paths rather than lower classification accuracy). It is the only method to simultaneously achieve high structural quality and high practical applicability. On downstream tasks, ATLAS enables alternative discovery with P@1 = 85.71%, surpassing even human-curated lists (62.34%), and achieves the highest P@1 for repository retrieval. The taxonomy further reveals structural ecosystem trends that are difficult to obtain from flat tags or similarity methods: the shift from libraries to AI/ML applications (now 61% of newly community-adopted projects) becomes visible only through hierarchical, type-based categorization. An interactive taxonomy explorer is available at https://atlas-taxonomy.netlify.app/

</details>


### [443] [The Alignment Problem in Constrained Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21619)
*Matteo Biagiola,Jahrim Gabriele Cesario,Luca Di Grazia,George Zakhour,Guido Salvaneschi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 在代码生成的约束解码中，约束器（如类型系统）与语言模型、目标规范语言之间的不对齐问题（不完整/不完备）会导致功能正确性大幅下降（最高达97%），不完整的约束将模型推向低概率区域，反而使无约束解码效果更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前的工作忽视了约束解码中一个关键问题：约束器（如类型系统）与语言模型及目标规范语言（如TypeScript）之间的对齐问题。约束器的不完整性（拒绝属于目标语言的程序）或不完备性（允许不属于目标语言的程序）会扭曲语言模型分布，可能对代码生成有害。

Method: 使用7种语言模型、2种目标语言、2种约束器（在解码时强制执行类型和语法），研究语言模型对不同不完整性水平的反应，在三个基准上比较约束解码与无约束解码的功能正确性。

Result: 当约束器不完整时，无约束解码在功能正确性上显著优于约束解码。不完整性将模型推向程序空间的低概率区域，导致生成频繁超时，功能正确性最高降低97%。

Conclusion: 让社区认识到约束解码中不对齐问题的负面影响，并为如何设计对代码生成系统有益的约束器提供了定量见解。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in code generation, but their outputs frequently contain syntax or type errors that result in compilation failures. Constrained decoding has been proposed as a solution to mitigate compilation errors by construction, improving functional correctness as a byproduct. However, previous works overlook a critical aspect of constrained decoding: the alignment between constrainer (e.g., types), language model and the target specification language (e.g., TypeScript). Misalignment is caused by the constrainer being incomplete--rejecting programs that belong to the target--or unsound--allowing programs that are not part of the target. The bias created by incompleteness distorts the language model distribution, and can be detrimental for code generation.
  We evaluate this hypothesis using seven language models, two target languages, two constrainers, enforcing types and syntax during decoding, and we study how language models react to varying levels of incompleteness. On three benchmarks, when the constrainer is incomplete, unconstrained decoding significantly outperforms constrained decoding in terms of functional correctness. Incompleteness pushes the model into low-probability regions of the program space, causing the generation to frequently time out, and reducing functional correctness by up to 97%.
  These contributions make the community aware of the negative effects of misalignment in constrained decoding, and provide quantitative insights on how to design constrainers that are beneficial for code generation systems with formal guarantees.

</details>


### [444] [Assessing Language Models for Salient Class Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21629)
*Bo Xiong,Chaoran Cai,Kaipeng Xiong,Chong Wang,Peng Liang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究使用语言模型（LMs）直接从代码提交中识别显著类（salient classes），无需特征工程、图构建或训练。构建了ApacheJavaCM数据集，评估了GPT-5.4、DeepSeek-V3.2和Qwen3.5-9B等模型。结果表明，LMs大幅优于现有基线，且9B参数的小语言模型在少样本提示下可达到与大型闭源LLM相当的性能，为工业应用提供了低成本、低隐私风险的方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码评审中，当提交修改多个类时，准确识别主要修改的显著类（salient classes）能为评审者提供有效的导航入口，促进程序理解。现有方法依赖复杂的程序分析流程（如AST解析、类关系提取、特征工程、依赖图构建），成本高且实现复杂。

Method: 1. 构建ApacheJavaCM数据集（7,911个提交，25,914个标注类）；2. 评估两个LLM（GPT-5.4、DeepSeek-V3.2）和一个SLM（Qwen3.5-9B）；3. 采用三种提示策略：零样本、少样本和思维链；4. 与最强可复现的SOTA基线进行比较。

Result: 语言模型大幅优于现有SOTA基线，且在不同提交特征和模型选择上保持稳定。Qwen3.5-9B在少样本提示下性能与GPT-5.4相当。

Conclusion: 轻量级、可本地部署的小语言模型足以胜任工业级显著类识别任务，可降低依赖闭源LLM带来的成本和隐私壁垒。

Abstract: Code review requires reviewers to understand the core intent of code changes, which becomes difficult when a commit modifies multiple classes. In such commits, one or more primarily modified classes, referred to as salient classes, may induce modifications in other classes. Accurate identification of salient classes offers reviewers an effective entry point to navigate code changes and facilitates program comprehension. Existing state-of-the-art approaches rely on complex program-analysis procedures, including Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) parsing, class relation extraction, handcrafted feature engineering, or dependency graph construction. To this end, we study whether language models (LMs) can identify salient classes directly from commits without feature engineering, graph construction, or training. We first construct a new dataset ApacheJavaCM, derived from the ApacheCM dataset, containing 7,911 commits and 25,914 labeled classes. On this dataset, we systematically evaluate whether LMs can identify salient classes directly from commits and compare with the strongest reproducible state-of-the-art (SOTA) baseline. The evaluation covers two large language models (LLMs), GPT-5.4 and DeepSeek-V3.2, one small language model (SLM), Qwen3.5-9B, and three prompting strategies: zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought. The LMs substantially outperform the baseline while remaining stable across commit characteristics and selected LMs. We also found that, for salient class identification tasks, a 9B-parameter open-source SLM, Qwen3.5-9B, under few-shot prompting, achieves performance comparable to that of a much larger closed-source LLM, GPT-5.4. These results suggest that lightweight, locally deployable SLMs are sufficient for industrial salient class identification tasks and can reduce both cost and privacy barriers associated with relying on closed-source LLMs.

</details>


### [445] [ConcernBERT: Learning Responsibilities Using Class Membership](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21647)
*J. Lefever,J. Xu,Y. Cai,R. Kazman,E. Pisch*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出ConcernBERT，一种基于BERT的实体级嵌入模型，通过三元组损失和类成员上下文优化方法和属性的嵌入空间，以识别具有共同职责的程序实体组。作者还贡献了一个包含200万以上Java文件的大型数据集。实验表明，ConcernBERT在恢复原始类成员关系上显著优于现有模型，为架构恢复、提取类重构和内聚度量等下游任务提供了基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有软件设计原则（关注点分离、高内聚、单一职责）的应用仍停留在哲学层面，依赖开发者直觉和经验，缺乏可操作的技术手段。识别共同承担职责的程序实体组（如方法、属性）是许多软件任务（上帝类分解、提取类重构、内聚度量）的关键，但可靠地识别这些组仍然是一个挑战。

Method: 提出ConcernBERT模型：1）基于BERT的嵌入模型，在实体级别（方法、属性）进行训练；2）使用三元组损失（triplet loss）直接优化嵌入空间中方法和属性的相对位置；3）利用类成员关系上下文学习职责和关注点；4）构建大规模复制数据集，涵盖6000多个仓库、200万以上Java文件用于训练和评估。评估方式：将来自两个或多个类的方法合并成未标注的组，测试模型恢复原始类成员关系的能力。

Result: ConcernBERT在恢复原始类成员关系任务上显著优于现有模型，证明了其在编码关注点级别语义方面的有效性。

Conclusion: ConcernBERT在识别具有共同职责的程序实体组方面表现出色，为下游任务（架构恢复、提取类重构、内聚度量）建立了坚实基础。

Abstract: The principles of separation of concerns, high cohesion, and single responsibility are among the most well-known in software design. However, their application often remains philosophical rather than actionable, relying heavily on developers' intuition and experience. Many software tasks, such as god class decomposition, extract class refactoring, and cohesion measurement, depend on techniques for identifying cohesive groups of program entities, that is, entities that collectively fulfill a common responsibility. Yet reliably identifying such groups remains a challenge. In this paper, we propose ConcernBERT, a BERT-based embedding model trained at the entity level that uses triplet loss to directly optimize the relative positioning of methods and attributes in the embedding space, and uses class-membership context to learn responsibilities and concerns. We also contribute a large-scale replication dataset for training and evaluation. Our dataset spans over two million Java files across more than six thousand repositories. To evaluate ConcernBERT, we merge methods from two or more classes into unlabeled groups and test the model's ability to recover the original class memberships. ConcernBERT achieves significantly higher performance than existing models, demonstrating its effectiveness at encoding concern-level semantics and establishing a strong foundation for downstream tasks such as architecture recovery, extract class refactoring, and cohesion measurement.

</details>


### [446] [Humor in Software Testing Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21682)
*Isabella Graßl,Benoit Baudry*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过在加拿大和德国大学的软件测试入门课程中引入幽默元素，通过混合方法研究证明了幽默能显著提升学生的情感投入、归属感和创造性思维，尤其对女学生效果更明显，表明幽默是一种低门槛、有益的教学方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件测试通常被认为单调乏味，影响学生的情感投入；虽然已有研究指出幽默在专业软件开发中能提升参与度，但幽默在软件测试教育中的效果尚不明确。

Method: 在加拿大和德国大学的软件测试入门课程中引入幽默元素，采用混合方法研究（定量+定性）收集学生反馈。

Result: 幽默对学生软件测试体验有强烈的积极影响：学生认为测试更具吸引力、不那么单调，感觉更舒适和被接纳，创造性思维有所提升；这些效果在女学生中尤为显著，尤其在归属感方面。

Conclusion: 幽默是一种低门槛的教学方法，对学生有益，有潜力创造更具包容性的学习环境。

Abstract: Software testing is often perceived as monotonous, which can negatively influence students' emotional engagement with testing. While prior work suggests that humor can increase engagement in professional software development contexts, we know little about humor's effect in software testing education. This paper explores how humorous elements in software testing assignments affect students' emotional engagement, sense of belonging, and creative thinking. We introduced humor in introductory software testing courses at universities in Canada and Germany, and conducted a mixed-methods study with students. Our results show that humor had a strong positive influence on students' experiences of software testing. Students perceived testing as more engaging and less monotonous, felt more comfortable and accepted in class, and reported increased creative thinking about testing tasks. These effects were particularly strong for female students, especially with respect to sense of belonging. Our findings suggest that humor represents a low-threshold pedagogical approach which is beneficial for students, and has the potential to create a more welcoming learning environment.

</details>


### [447] [Towards Imputation of Pre-Trained Language Model Metadata using Semantic Fingerprinting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21787)
*Adekunle Ajibode,Oussama Ben Sghaier,Keheliya Gallaba,Bram Adams,Ahmed E. Hassan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 针对预训练语言模型（PTLM）生态系统中元数据缺失问题，提出SemFin方法，通过结合Hugging Face配置文件与仓库标签自动补全模型元数据并重建模型谱系链，在317,133个模型上验证有效，元数据补全后复用方法链扩展75.9%，许可链扩展53.6%，为AI物料清单（AIBOM）的自动化构建提供支撑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PTLM仓库（如Hugging Face）存在大量缺失元数据（许可、复用方法、流水线标签、模型类型、训练库等）的问题，导致模型间复杂的谱系关系难以追溯，无法像传统软件生态系统那样可靠地获取来源信息。

Method: 提出Semantic Fingerprinting (SemFin)方法，将Hugging Face配置文件与模型仓库标签结合，自动推断缺失的模型元数据字段并重建模型谱系链。

Result: 在317,133个PTLM的大规模数据集上，SemFin相较于传播式方法Graph Avg和Hub Avg，预测准确率分别提升31.4%和26.6%；能对16.6%的孤立模型补全元数据；补全后复用方法链扩展75.9%，许可链扩展53.6%，发现86个之前不可见的复用方法模式，不兼容许可模式仅从34.8%增至36.8%。

Conclusion: 配置文件编码了实例化与复用模型所需的技术要求，可作为模型复用的结构蓝图。自动导出的结构信号能够支持AI物料清单（AIBOM）的自动化构建，将元数据从易错的手动声明转化为从模型工件中直接推断的信息。

Abstract: Pre-trained language models (PTLMs) hosted on platforms such as Hugging Face form complex lineage structures similar to software dependency graphs. However, unlike traditional software ecosystems, PTLM repositories often lack reliable provenance due to missing metadata, such as licenses, reuse methods, pipeline tags, model types, and training libraries. To address this gap, we introduce Semantic Fingerprinting (SemFin), a lightweight approach that combines Hugging Face (HF) configuration files with model repository tags to automatically impute missing model metadata fields and reconstruct model lineage chains. We evaluate SemFin on a large-scale dataset of 317,133 PTLMs. Our results show that configuration files typically encode the technical requirements necessary to instantiate and reuse models, enabling them to serve as a structural blueprint for model reuse, particularly for transformer-based architectures. By combining these configuration files with model repository tags, SemFin significantly outperforms the existing propagation-based imputation approaches, improving prediction accuracy by up to 31.4% and 26.6% compared to Graph Avg and Hub Avg baselines. Importantly, SemFin also imputes metadata for 16.6% of isolated models where propagation-based methods fail. Applying SemFin to impute missing reuse-method and license metadata for 167,089 unlabeled models reveals that traceable reuse method chains expand by 75.9% and license lineage chains by 53.6%, uncovering 86 previously invisible reuse method patterns, while the proportion of incompatible license patterns only increases from 34.8% to 36.8%. These findings demonstrate how automatically derived structural signals can support the automated construction of AI Bills of Materials (AIBOMs), helping transform metadata from an error-prone manual declaration into information inferred directly from model artifacts.

</details>


### [448] [Is Agent Code Less Maintainable Than Human Code?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21804)
*Shaswat Patel,Betty Li Hou,Arun Purohit,Kai Xu,Jane Pan,He He,Valerie Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出CodeThread框架，用于对比评估编码智能体与人类代码的可维护性。实验发现，在后续维护任务中，基于智能体代码的解决率比人类代码最多下降13.1%，传统可维护性指标无法解释该差异，而输入验证、错误处理等细微行为差异及下游代码规模、任务难度才是关键因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码智能体在单任务上表现优异，但未来开发者在其代码基础上构建时的可维护性尚不明确，可能存在复合下游效应。

Method: 提出CodeThread框架，在仓库级编码基准上构建受控实验，对四个前沿编码智能体和四个基准进行评估，结合回归分析探究影响机制。

Result: 智能体基于智能体代码解决任务的效果显著低于基于人类代码，任务解决率下降最高达13.1%；传统可维护性指标无法解释该差异，而输入验证、错误处理等行为差异以及下游代码规模和任务难度是关键信号。

Conclusion: 评估编码智能体不能仅看即时任务解决能力，还需关注代码可维护性；研究指出了智能体代码引入下游错误的潜在来源。

Abstract: Maintainability is a core dimension of software engineering, shaping how code is written, reviewed, and developed over time. While coding agents have demonstrated strong performance on single-issue tasks, it remains unclear how maintainable their code is when future agents build on top of it, potentially leading to compounding downstream effects. We investigate how agent code compares to human code in these maintenance settings, presenting CodeThread, a framework to construct controlled experiments from repository-level coding benchmarks. Applying CodeThread to four frontier coding agents and four benchmarks, we find that agents are less effective at resolving tasks when building on agent code compared to human code, with task resolve rate drops of up to 13.1%. Regression analysis reveals that many traditional software engineering maintainability metrics do not explain this difference. Instead, the clearest signals are subtler behavioral differences in agent code, such as changes to input validation and error handling, along with differences in downstream code size and task difficulty. These findings highlight the need to evaluate these systems not only by immediate task resolution but also by code maintainability, and point to potential sources of downstream errors introduced by agent code.

</details>


### [449] [GitReq: A Gold Standard Dataset for Software Quality Requirements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21810)
*Farha Kamal,Md Humaun Kabir,Md Rakibul Islam*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文构建并发布了GitReq数据集，包含6,302条经专家验证的软件需求，涵盖8个ISO/IEC 25010:2011质量类别，并基于四个大语言模型建立了零样本分类基线，最高宏平均F1达到0.641。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GitHub问题追踪器中包含大量开发者撰写的质量关注点（如性能瓶颈、安全漏洞），但尚无公开数据集将这些关注点细粒度地分类到软件质量类别中。

Method: 从55,588个原始GitHub候选中通过类别特定的三信号挖掘、独立的非功能性需求和功能性需求预处理流水线（每类别含不同参数）以及专家人工标注（Fleiss' Kappa≈0.72）构建了6,302条经专家验证的需求数据集。

Result: 零样本评估中，GPT-5.2达到最高宏平均F1为0.641。

Conclusion: GitReq数据集已公开释出，可推动自动化需求分类和软件质量分析领域的研究。

Abstract: GitHub issue trackers contain millions of developer-written quality concerns, including performance bottlenecks and security vulnerabilities, yet no publicly available GitHub dataset classifies these into fine-grained software quality categories. We construct and release GitReq GitHub Requirement Issue, comprising 6,302 expert-validated requirements mined from 55,588 raw GitHub candidates across 4,080 repositories, labeled across eight ISO/IEC 25010:2011-aligned categories: Performance, Security, Portability, Availability, Fault-tolerance, Scalability, Maintainability, and a Functional baseline. Dataset construction involved category-specific triple-signal GitHub mining, separate non-functional requirement (NFR) and functional requirement (FR) preprocessing pipelines with per-category parameters, and expert human annotation achieving substantial inter-annotator agreement (Fleiss' Kappa~=~0.72). Zero-shot evaluation with four large language models (LLMs) establishes baselines, with GPT-5.2 reaching the highest macro-averaged F1 of 0.641. GitReq is publicly released with full materials to advance research in automated requirement classification and software quality analysis.

</details>


### [450] [Steer, Don't Solve: Training Small Critic Models for Large Code Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21811)
*Shubham Gandhi,Yiqing Xie,Atharva Naik,Ruichen Zhu,Carolyn Rose*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出通过训练小型批评模型（Critic）为代码智能体提供轨迹内反馈，替代传统端到端训练中策略级推理不足的问题。在SWE-bench Verified上，批评模型可迁移至未见过的智能体，提升3.0-5.2个点，同时降低30-92倍成本，且能缩短轨迹长度，实现更优性能与更低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端代码智能体训练资源消耗大，且在策略级推理上陷入瓶颈，因为联合优化代码执行和策略推理导致后者发展不足。现有批评模型是事后性的，仅对已完成轨迹打分，无法引导智能体。

Method: 冻结智能体参数，额外训练一个小型批评模型，通过监督微调（SFT）为智能体提供轨迹内（intra-trajectory）反馈信号。

Result: 在SWE-bench Verified上，基于CWM-32B轨迹训练的批评模型可迁移到两个未见过的智能体（提升+3.0至+3.8点）；加入目标智能体轨迹后，CWM-32B提升+3.8，两个Qwen智能体提升+4.4至+5.2，批评模型成本仅为强教师的1/30至1/92。在Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B上，批评引导的系统准确率25.2%（vs. 20.8%），成本$0.04（vs. $0.11）。

Conclusion: 小型且训练良好的批评模型是扩展智能体训练的实用补充方案，既能提升性能，又能降低推理成本。

Abstract: End-to-end code agent training is resource-intensive and plateaus on the strategy-level reasoning needed to resolve code issues, since jointly optimizing code-level execution and strategy-level reasoning leaves the latter underdeveloped. Instead, we freeze the agent and add a critic model to supply that signal. Prior code critics are post-hoc, scoring completed trajectories rather than steering the agent; we instead train a small critic that provides intra-trajectory feedback via Supervised Fine-Tuning. On SWE-bench Verified, a critic trained on CWM-32B trajectories transfers to two unseen agents (gains of +3.0 to +3.8 points), and adding target-agent trajectories to the corpus increases the gain to +3.8 on CWM-32B and +4.4 to +5.2 on two Qwen agents, at 30-92x lower critic cost than a strong teacher. On Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B, the critic-guided system is both more accurate (25.2% vs. 20.8%) and cheaper (\$0.04 vs. \$0.11) than the agent alone, because the critic also shortens trajectories. Our results show that a small, well-trained critic is a practical complement to scaling agent training. Code: https://github.com/shubhamrgandhi/critic-training. Data and models: https://huggingface.co/collections/shubhamrgandhi/critic-training-for-code-agents

</details>


### [451] [G-Issue: Analyzing Lifetime and Evolution of Issue-related Artifacts from Open Source Repositories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21837)
*Sayed Mohsin Reza,Saif Uddin Mahmud,Omar Badreddin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出并评估了G-Issue工具，用于挖掘软件仓库中的issue相关工件，相比通用Python API，该工具挖掘速度更快但内存消耗更大。同时研究了issue的生命周期和随时间演化规律，发现可根据这些特征对issue进行优先级排序，有助于issue管理、开发者分配和质量控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件开发者或贡献者在社区驱动的开发过程中报告的错误、缺陷和文档缺失等问题被视为重要反馈，对增强软件功能、文档和质量至关重要。如果问题未能分配给合适的开发者，软件质量将下降且最终无法使用。因此，有必要分析软件issue相关工件以理解软件行为。

Method: 提出了issue相关工件挖掘工具G-Issue，将其与当前其他先进工具进行性能对比。同时研究了知名且维护良好的仓库中issue的生命周期和随时间演化的规律。

Result: G-Issue在挖掘issue相关工件时速度优于通用Python API，但内存消耗更大。研究结果表明，可以根据issue生命周期和演化特征对issue进行优先级排序。

Conclusion: 上述发现为issue管理、开发者分配和质量控制提供了新的视角。G-Issue工具已开源，网址为https://www.smreza.com/projects/modelmine/issues.php。

Abstract: Software developers or contributors report issues related to bugs, errors, and missing documentation during community-based software development. These issues are treated as feedback and are crucial to enhancing software new features, documentation, and quality. If software issues are not being addressed with a correct developer, software quality degrades and is unable to use in the end. Hence, it is essential to analyze the software issue-related artifacts to understand the behavior of the software. This paper investigates the performance of the proposed issue-related artifacts mining tool G-Issue with other state-of-the-art tools. We also investigate issue lifetime and evolution of issues over time among well-known and maintained repositories. The results show that G-Issue is faster in mining issue-related artifacts but takes more memory than general Python API during mining issue mining. The results depict that we can prioritize issues based on issue lifetime and evolution. Such results may provide a new horizon about issues that can help in issue management, developer assignment, and quality management. G-Issue URL: https://www.smreza.com/projects/modelmine/issues.php

</details>


### [452] [Skills for the future software profession: beyond agentic AI!](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21894)
*Sungmin Kang,Baishakhi Ray,Abhik Roychoudhury*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过2026年在纽约和新加坡举办的两场圆桌讨论，总结了AI编程代理时代软件工程师所需的核心技能，发现验证与验证（V&V）的重要性日益增加，并据此提出了未来软件工程师培训和教育的建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着编程代理（coding agents）迅速改变软件工程实践，研究者希望明确未来软件工程师需要具备哪些核心技能，以便为教育和培训提供指导。

Method: 组织了两场分别于2026年在纽约和新加坡举行的圆桌讨论，邀请研究人员和工业从业者参与，通过讨论和轶事总结关键发现。

Result: 验证与验证（verification and validation）的重要性随代理处理实现任务而日益增加，这是从活动中提炼出的关键发现之一。

Conclusion: 识别了代理时代开发人员所需的技能，并对未来几年软件工程师的培训和教育提出了启示。

Abstract: As coding agents are rapidly changing software engineering, a natural question is: what are the core skills needed by future software engineers? To identify where software engineering is headed and thus what skills will be needed, we summarize the results of two round-tables with researchers and industrial practitioners, held in 2026 in New York and Singapore. One key finding is that verification and validation is increasing in importance as agents handle implementation, as highlighted by anecdotes from the events. From our observations, we identify the skills developers need in the agentic era of development, with implications for training and educating future software engineers in coming years.

</details>


### [453] [Bringing Managed Language Support to WebAssembly with External Library Linking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21919)
*Shuyao Jiang,Ruiying Zeng,Yangfan Zhou,Michael R. Lyu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出WALL-E框架，通过客户端-服务器架构将托管语言库与WebAssembly模块连接，无需复杂的运行时嵌套即可在Wasm环境中支持托管语言，性能比运行时嵌套方案提升数百倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WebAssembly目前主要支持C/C++/Rust等编译型语言，缺乏对Python、Java、JavaScript等托管语言的良好支持，限制了其在机器学习和数据处理等依赖托管语言生态的领域中的应用。

Method: 采用外部库链接策略，通过客户端-服务器架构将Wasm模块与运行在原生运行时中的托管语言库连接起来，避免了双虚拟机架构的额外开销。

Result: 支持十种托管语言无需框架修改，相比运行时嵌套方案实现数百倍的速度提升，通信开销低。

Conclusion: WALL-E增强了Wasm在云端和边缘计算中的实用性，能够高效支持多语言应用。

Abstract: WebAssembly (Wasm) has emerged as a powerful bytecode format for running applications with near-native performance in portable and secure environments. However, while Wasm currently supports compiled languages like C, C++, and Rust, it lacks robust support for managed languages such as Python, Java, and JavaScript. This limitation hinders the deployment of applications in domains like machine learning and data processing that rely heavily on managed language ecosystems. To address this, we propose WALL-E, a novel framework to integrate managed languages into Wasm environments without complex runtime nesting or recompilation. WALL-E employs a unique external library linking strategy, using a client-server architecture to connect Wasm modules with managed language libraries running in their native runtimes. This approach preserves the native execution speed and language feature compatibility of managed languages by eliminating the overhead associated with double-layer virtual machines. Our evaluation shows that WALL-E supports ten managed languages without framework modifications and achieves a speedup of hundreds of times over the runtime nesting solution, with low communication overhead. WALL-E enhances the practicality of Wasm in cloud and edge computing, enabling efficient multi-language applications.

</details>


### [454] [A11YRepair: Bridging Web Accessibility Barriers via Knowledge-Enhanced Divide-and-Conquer Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21926)
*Kai Huang,Ling Zhu,Jian Zhang,Xiaofei Xie,Chunyang Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出A11YRepair，一个基于LLM的Web无障碍性修复框架，通过分治策略将需要协调编辑的违规聚类并按根因分解，结合WCAG领域知识进行故障定位和补丁生成。在60个真实项目中，A11YRepair的补丁已被Google、Microsoft、Facebook等多家公司的开源项目合并。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Web无障碍性工具主要关注违规检测而非修复，而最新APR系统在处理真实A11Y违规时表现不佳，因为A11Y问题通常表现为每页多个结构相关的违规，需要跨多个文件的协调编辑，现有修复系统逐个处理每个bug，忽略了它们之间的关系且未整合WCAG领域规则。

Method: A11YRepair采用分治策略：首先对需要协调编辑的违规进行聚类以减少冗余定位，然后按根因分解每个聚类，使LLM能够生成聚焦且一致的补丁。框架进一步引入WCAG驱动的知识来增强故障定位和补丁合成阶段的领域感知能力。

Result: 在包含60个真实网络项目的A11YBench基准上，A11YRepair在修复效果和成本上均优于最新基线方法。消融实验验证了分治设计和选择性领域知识集成的重要性。修复的补丁已被Google、Microsoft、Facebook、IBM、K8s、Docker和阿里巴巴等公司的开源项目合并。

Conclusion: A11YRepair通过将多文件协调编辑问题转化为可管理的子问题，并融入WCAG领域知识，有效解决了Web A11Y修复的独特挑战，在真实项目中证明了其实用价值。

Abstract: Web accessibility (A11Y), which ensures web content is perceivable and usable for users with disabilities, is a critical requirement for modern web applications. Yet existing tooling overwhelmingly focuses on detecting A11Y violations rather than repairing them. Automated program repair (APR) techniques appear promising for this setting, but our study shows that state-of-the-art APR systems perform poorly when applied to real-world A11Y violations. Unlike conventional sparse-bug scenarios, web A11Y issues often manifest as multiple structurally related violations per page, requiring coordinated edits across multiple files. Existing repair systems fail to manage this multi-fault scale, as they handle each bug individually without considering their relationships or incorporating domain rules such as the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG). We propose A11YRepair, an LLM-based framework for web A11Y repair. A11YRepair introduces a divide-and-conquer workflow that first clusters violations requiring coordinated edits to reduce redundant localization, and then decomposes each cluster by root cause so the LLM can generate focused and consistent patches. The framework further incorporates WCAG-driven knowledge to strengthen domain awareness during both fault localization and patch synthesis. To support systematic evaluation, we construct A11YBench, a benchmark of 60 real-world web projects collected from GitHub. Experimental results show that A11YRepair achieves higher repair effectiveness and lower cost than state-of-the-art baselines, and ablation studies confirm the importance of its divide-and-conquer design and selective domain knowledge integration. Specifically, patches generated by A11YRepair have been merged into open-source projects from Google, Microsoft, Facebook, IBM, K8s, Docker, and Alibaba, demonstrating its practical value.

</details>


### [455] [Cross-Platform Software Birthmarking for Real-World Binaries via Intermediate Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21988)
*Haruaki Tamada*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Ghidra P-code统一中间表示的跨平台软件胎记方法，在多种架构上实现了高度一致性（r=0.9846），同时发现Windows二进制文件存在库函数导致的"稀释效应"，并验证了Simpson指数具有优越的区分能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有软件胎记方法在跨平台场景下的鲁棒性缺乏系统评估，亟需一种能统一处理不同平台二进制文件的胎记方案。

Method: 通过Ghidra P-code将不同格式的二进制文件提升为通用中间表示，实现跨架构的统一胎记提取与分析。

Result: 跨CPU架构相似度一致性极高（r=0.9846），独立于ISA细节；在Windows二进制文件中观察到库函数导致的"稀释效应"；Simpson指数在该噪声环境下表现出更好的区分能力。

Conclusion: 明确了鲁棒跨平台胎记的实践能力边界与关键需求，为实际部署提供了指导。

Abstract: Software birthmarking detects plagiarism through characteristic program features, yet cross-platform resilience remains under-evaluated. This paper proposes a unified birthmarking approach for real-world binaries by lifting disparate formats into a common intermediate representation via Ghidra P-code. Experiments across diverse platforms and languages demonstrate exceptional consistency across CPU architectures ($r=0.9846$), independent of ISA (Instruction Set Architecture) specific details. The study also identifies a ``dilution effect'' in Windows binaries, in which the proliferation of library-derived functions degrades similarity scores. Despite this noise, the Simpson index demonstrates superior discriminative power. These findings clarify the practical capabilities and essential requirements for robust cross-platform birthmarking.

</details>


### [456] [From Driving Videos to Simulatable Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21993)
*Alexandre Levy,Ernest Valveny Llobet,Antonio Manuel López*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出D-V2S框架，通过两阶段流程（驾驶记录分析器+场景生成器）将真实驾驶视频自动转化为可执行的仿真测试场景，实现了90%语义元素保留率和75%的用户偏好率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶车辆面临从常规到罕见事件的各种驾驶场景，为评估安全性，需要以可控、可重复、可扩展的方式复现这些场景。现有方法难以自动从真实驾驶视频生成可仿真场景，因此需要一种端到端的自动化框架。

Method: D-V2S包含两个阶段：(1) 驾驶记录分析器(DRA)使用视觉语言模型(VLM)结合设计的提示词，从输入视频生成自然语言描述，捕捉道路布局和动态交通交互；(2) 场景生成器(SG)使用大语言模型(LLM)结合条件上下文，将这些描述转化为可执行的仿真场景。

Result: 仿真实验表明，D-V2S生成场景保留了视频中90%的相关语义元素；消融实验显示VLM的选择对DRA至关重要；SG相较其他最先进方法获得了75%的用户偏好率。

Conclusion: D-V2S能够有效将真实驾驶视频转化为可仿真场景，为自动驾驶安全性评估提供了一个自动化、可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) face driving scenarios ranging from routine traffic to rare events. To assess safety it is crucial to reproduce these scenarios in a controllable, repeatable, and scalable manner, with simulation playing a key role. This paper introduces D-V2S, a novel framework that automatically generates simulatable driving scenarios from driving videos. D-V2S operates in two stages: a Driving Record Analyzer (DRA) uses a vision language model (VLM) with our designed prompt to produce natural-language descriptions from input videos, capturing road layouts and dynamic traffic interactions; subsequently, a Scenario Generator (SG) uses a large language model (LLM) and our conditioning context to translate these descriptions into executable scenarios. Using simulations, we show that D-V2S generates scenarios where 90% of the relevant semantic elements of the videos are present. We also provide qualitative results demonstrating D-V2S's capability to transform real-world driving videos into simulatable scenarios. Moreover, we provide both semantic and human driven ablative analyses of D-V2S's modules. In particular, we show how the VLM choice matters for DRA, and how our SG achieves a 75% preference rate over other state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [457] [CodeTeam: An LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Framework for Repository-Level Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22082)
*Yifei Wang,Ruiyin Li,Peng Liang,Qiong Feng,Zengyang Li,Mojtaba Shahin,Arif Ali Khan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出CodeTeam，一个基于LLM的多智能体框架，用于从自然语言需求文档生成完整软件仓库。该框架将规划、决策和实现分离为不同阶段，通过多架构师草图设计、CTO评估选择、依赖感知调度和Git协调等机制，在SketchEval和NL2Repo-Bench基准上显著优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言到仓库生成（NL2Repo）相比函数级代码生成面临更长的规划跨度、跨文件接口稳定性以及跨文件不一致性的迭代调试挑战，现有方法难以有效解决这些问题。

Method: CodeTeam采用多智能体框架：规划阶段由多个Architect智能体生成软件设计草图（SDS）并由CTO智能体评估选择为机器可检查的契约；实现阶段Developer智能体在依赖感知调度器下生成代码，结合轻量级Git协调，QA智能体运行测试并驱动迭代修复。

Result: 在SketchEval上，CodeTeam的PE和SFT变体相比CodeS基线分别提升4.1和2.9个绝对SketchBLEU点。在NL2Repo-Bench上，PE和SFT设置分别达到34.6%和42.3%的最高平均测试通过率。消融实验显示项目特定开发者分配和检索增强规划分别贡献了9.9%和8.1%的相对SketchBLEU提升。

Conclusion: CodeTeam通过分离规划与实现、多智能体协作以及依赖感知调度等机制，有效解决了NL2Repo任务中的跨文件协调和长程规划挑战，且草图质量改进可转化为功能正确性的提升。

Abstract: Natural language to repository generation (NL2Repo) requires a system to construct an entire software repository from a natural-language requirements document. Compared with function-level code generation, this task demands longer planning horizons, stable interfaces across files, and iterative debugging of cross-file inconsistencies. To address these challenges, we propose CodeTeam, an LLM-based multi-agent framework that separates planning, decision making, and implementation into distinct, coordinated stages. In the planning stage, multiple Architect agents draft competing software design sketches (SDS), optionally grounded by retrieved design references. A CTO agent then evaluates, selects, and normalizes the most promising SDS into a machine-checkable contract that specifies file ownership, public interfaces, and dependency constraints. In the implementation stage, Developer agents generate code under a dependency-aware scheduler with bounded context and lightweight Git-based coordination, while a QA agent runs tests and drives iterative repairs. On the synthesis-based SketchEval benchmark, we explicitly compare CodeTeam's prompt-engineering (PE) and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) variants with the corresponding CodeS variants, where CodeTeam improves the overall SketchBLEU by 4.1 and 2.9 absolute points, respectively. On the execution-based NL2Repo-Bench benchmark, used as an external validation protocol, CodeTeam achieves the highest average test pass rate in both settings (34.6% PE, 42.3% SFT), confirming that the sketch-improvements extend to functional correctness under upstream test suites. Ablation results show that project-specific developer allocation and retrieval-augmented planning each contribute substantially to the SketchBLEU improvement (9.9% and 8.1% relative, respectively). CodeTeam and the experimental results are available at https://github.com/WhitenWhiten/CodeTeam

</details>


### [458] [TraceView: Interactive Visualization of Agentic Program Repair Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22110)
*Amirali Sajadi,Tu Nguyen,Kimmie Huynh,Esteban Parra,Preetha Chatterjee*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: TraceView是一个交互式工具，用于标注和可视化LLM-based自动程序修复(APR)代理的推理轨迹，帮助开发者诊断、复现和预防修复失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的APR代理只输出最终补丁的成功或失败，无法展示代理的推理过程、重复行为或与任务对齐情况，导致修复失败难以诊断、复现和预防。

Method: TraceView将代理轨迹组织为Thought、Action、Result三个组件，支持语义关系标注和诊断，以图视图形式呈现轨迹，并提供关系过滤器、补丁结果摘要、指标和节点级证据面板。

Result: 通过五项研究者的问卷调查用户研究，参与者报告TraceView使轨迹更易扫描，其概览到细节的工作流帮助他们更好地理解修复行为。

Conclusion: TraceView有效解决了APR代理轨迹可视化与诊断的难题，为开发者提供了理解修复行为的有效工具。

Abstract: LLM-based automated program repair (APR) agents generate patches to fix software bugs with minimal human intervention. These agents often produce long trajectories of reasoning, tool use, and feedback to produce candidate patches. Final patch outcomes show whether a repair attempt succeeded or failed, but they do not show how the agent reached that outcome, or where the process became repetitive or misaligned with the task. This makes agentic repair failures difficult to diagnose, reproduce, and prevent. To help developers address these challenges, we present TraceView, an interactive tool for labeling and visualizing repair trajectories from APR systems. TraceView organizes raw and pre-labeled agentic runs with Thought, Action, and Result components to support semantic relation labeling and diagnosis, and renders the resulting trajectory as graph views. Furthermore, TraceView provides relation filters, patch outcome summaries, metrics, and node-level evidence panels to help users inspect how reasoning, actions, and feedback connect across the various steps of an agentic repair attempt. We evaluate TraceView with five researchers through a survey-based user study. Participants reported that TraceView made trajectories easier to scan and that its overview-to-detail workflow helped them better understand repair behavior. The TraceView source code is available at https://github.com/SOAR-Lab/agent-traj-visualization. A screencast of TraceView is available at https://youtu.be/9ZCh7Ifj2AQ.

</details>


### [459] [Failure Analysis in Transition: An Industry Survey of Challenges, Priorities, and Standardization Needs in Advanced Packaging and Heterogeneous Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22149)
*Himanandhan Reddy Kottur,Nusra Akter Takia,Mahamudul Hassan Fuad,Istiaq Firoz Shiam,Matthew Walsh,Navid Asadizanjani*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过对约100名从业者的匿名调查，分析了异构集成、芯粒架构、混合键合、背面技术及埋入式封装等新兴技术对失效分析领域的重塑影响。结果显示：69%的受访者专注于异构集成/芯粒/3D产品，封装与异构集成失效分析重要性评分高达7.92/10，混合键合以54%成为最难分析的新架构，高分辨率无损成像以8.18/10被评为最重要的未来加速技术，83%的受访者支持数据标准化框架。完整数据见附录A表II。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究异构集成、芯粒架构、混合键合、背面技术与埋入式封装等新兴技术如何重塑失效分析领域，以及从业者对此转型的视角和需求。

Method: 面向半导体设计、封装、系统、工具及失效分析领域广泛组织发放匿名问卷调查，收集约100份回复，涵盖组织背景、支持产品领域、失效分析优先级、关键瓶颈、样品制备挑战、新兴架构痛点及工作流加速与数据标准化需求。

Result: 异构集成/芯粒/3D产品占受访者69%；封装与异构集成失效分析重要性评分7.92/10；混合键合为最难分析架构（54%）；高分辨率无损成像为最重要未来加速技术（8.18/10）；83%受访者支持数据标准化框架。

Conclusion: 新兴异构集成架构对失效分析提出显著挑战，从业者高度认可高分辨率无损成像和数据标准化的重要性，行业亟需相应技术和方法论升级。

Abstract: Failure analysis is being reshaped by heterogeneous integration, chiplet-based architectures, hybrid bonding, backside technologies, & increasingly buried package structures. To examine how practitioners view this transition, an anonymous survey was distributed across a broad set of organizations involved in semiconductor design, packaging, systems, tools, & failure analysis. The survey collected approximately one hundred responses & probed organizational background, supported product domains, future priorities in failure analysis, critical bottlenecks, sample preparation challenges, emerging architecture specific pain points, & perceived needs for workflow acceleration & data standardization. The results show that heterogeneous integration, chiplet, and three-dimensional products dominate the respondent base at 69%, while package & heterogeneous integration failure analysis received the highest importance rating at 7.92 out of 10. Hybrid bonding emerged as the most difficult new architecture to analyze at 54%, higher-resolution non-destructive imaging ranked as the most important future accelerator at 8.18 out of 10, and 83% of respondents supported formalized data standardization frameworks. The complete survey data are provided in Appendix A (Table II) to improve transparency & support future benchmarking.

</details>


### [460] [Natural Language-Focused Software Engineering via Code-Documentation Equivalence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22247)
*Aryaz Eghbali,Zhongxin Liu,Michael Pradel*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出"文档-代码等效性"概念，并开发了Documentary方法来自动生成与代码等效的文档。实验表明该方法能为53.4%的函数生成等效文档，在代码理解和编辑任务中显著优于人类编写和基线方法生成的文档。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有软件文档常存在不完整、过时或不准确的问题，而在大语言模型广泛用于软件工程的时代，文档质量对模型性能至关重要，因此需要保证文档与代码的等价性。

Method: 提出Documentary方法，通过定义"文档-代码等效性"这一属性，自动为给定代码片段生成与之等效的文档，确保文档准确完整地描述代码。

Result: Documentary能为53.4%的函数级代码片段生成等效文档；在代码理解任务中，LLM预测函数输出的准确率比人工文档和基线方法分别提高12.8%-24.5%；开发者评价Documentary生成的文档比原始人工文档更有助于理解和编辑代码。

Conclusion: 文档-代码等效性是一个有价值的概念，Documentary方法能有效生成等效文档，显著提升LLM的代码理解能力和开发者的工作效率。

Abstract: Source code documentation is an integral part of software development and maintenance, as it helps in understanding the code and facilitates communication among developers. However, existing documentation is often incomplete, outdated, or inaccurate, which can lead to misunderstandings and errors. In the era of large language models (LLMs), which are being extensively used for software engineering tasks, the quality of documentation becomes even more critical, as documentation provides important context for the models. In this paper, we introduce the notion of documentation-to-code equivalence, a novel property that captures whether documentation accurately and completely describes the code it documents. We present a novel approach, called Documentary, to automatically generate equivalent documentation for a given code snippet. Our evaluation shows that Documentary can generate equivalent documentation for 53.4% of the evaluated function-level code snippets. To show the benefits of documentation-to-code equivalence, we describe and evaluate two software engineering tasks: code understanding and code editing. Our results show that documentation-to-code equivalence allows an LLM to predict the output of a function with 12.8--24.5% higher accuracy, when compared to human-written documentation and documentation generated by a baseline approach. Furthermore, human developers consider documentation generated by Documentary to be more useful for understanding and editing code than the original human-written documentation.

</details>


### [461] [Leveraging Large Language Models to Obscure Code Stylometry: A Comparative Study of GPT-3.5 and GPT-4](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22306)
*Saman Pordanesh,Benjamin Tan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本研究探讨了LLM（GPT-3.5/GPT-4）在保持代码功能的同时改变代码风格特征以规避作者归属检测的效果，实验表明多轮提示和结构化提示比单轮提示更有效，但功能完整性保持面临挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码风格计量学在软件作者归属和网络安全中至关重要，但LLM（如GPT-3.5/4）的出现给传统风格测量技术带来了新挑战，需要研究这些模型能否有效改变代码风格特征以规避检测。

Method: 使用GPT-3.5和GPT-4模型，结合不同的提示工程策略（单次/多次提示、结构化提示），通过随机森林分类器评估LLM对代码风格特征的混淆效果，并进行功能完整性验证。

Result: 单次提示与多次提示方法在效果上存在显著差异；详细的结构化提示对混淆效果至关重要；功能完整性保持在修改后面临挑战。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了作者归属技术在面对先进AI能力时的鲁棒性局限，为未来网络安全和软件工程发展提供了重要参考。

Abstract: In the rapidly evolving field of software development, code stylometry analyzing unique stylistic signatures of programmers plays a crit-ical role in authorship attribution and cybersecurity. Recent advancements in artificial intelligence, particularly Large Language Models (LLMs) like GPT-3.5 and GPT-4, have introduced new dimensions to this field, challenging traditional stylometry techniques. This study investigates the effectiveness of LLMs in altering code stylometry while preserving functionality and evaluates the impact of various prompt engineering strategies. Through comprehensive experiments, we assess how well these models can obscure stylistic signatures to avoid detection by a Random Forest classifier trained for authorship attribution. The results reveal significant differences in effectiveness between single-shot and multi-shot methods and highlight the importance of detailed, structured prompts. Additionally, functionality preservation checks demonstrate the challenges in maintaining code integrity post-modification. This research provides critical insights into the robustness of authorship attribution techniques against advanced AI capabilities, informing future cybersecurity and software engineering developments

</details>


### [462] [Reinforcement learning to improve large language model-based automated code compliance systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22402)
*Jack Wei Lun Shi,Minghao Dang,Wawan Solihin,Leong Hien Poh,Justin K. W. Yeoh*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了P4IR框架，结合监督微调（SFT）和分组相对策略优化（GRPO）来提高大型语言模型在建筑规范自动合规检查中的准确性，相比SFT基线在树编辑距离和词元级Levenshtein距离上分别降低了23.8%和38.6%，在零样本设置下优于多个主流LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的自动代码合规方法容易生成不正确和产生幻觉的计算机可处理规则，亟需提高生成中间表示（高层代码骨架）的准确性。

Method: 提出P4IR两阶段框架：第一阶段使用监督微调（SFT）向LLM注入领域知识；第二阶段使用分组相对策略优化（GRPO）优化生成的高层代码骨架中间表示的准确性。

Result: 相比SFT基线，树编辑距离降低23.8%，词元级Levenshtein距离降低38.6%；零样本设置下在代码结构和语义上优于Claude Opus、Sonnet 4.5、GPT-5.2、Qwen-3-Max和GLM-4.7等主流模型；GRPO阶段带来了小幅但统计显著的假阳性减少。

Conclusion: 将SFT与GRPO结合，直接针对领域特定目标进行优化，为构建更准确可靠的基于LLM的自动代码合规系统提供了一条可行路径。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based approaches for automated code compliance (ACC) of building regulations are prone to generating incorrect and hallucinated computer-processable rules. This paper introduces P4IR, a two-stage framework that uses supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to instill domain knowledge in an LLM, followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to improve the accuracy of the generated intermediate representations in the form of high-level code skeletons. The framework achieved reductions of up to 23.8% and 38.6% in tree edit distance and token-level Levenshtein distance respectively, relative to the SFT baselines. Comparative analysis demonstrates that this approach in a zero-shot setting outperforms leading LLMs in both code structure and semantics, specifically Claude Opus and Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5.2, Qwen-3-Max, and GLM-4.7, evaluated via few-shot prompting. Additionally, the GRPO stage produced a small yet statistically significant reduction in false positives. By combining SFT with GRPO to optimize directly for domain-specific objectives, this approach offers a path toward more accurate and reliable LLM-based ACC systems.

</details>


### [463] [Formal-Method-Guided Vibe Coding: Closing the Verification Loop on AI-Generated Safety-Critical Software Through Model-Driven Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22413)
*Ran Wei,Le Zhu,Haochi Wang,Jim Woodcock,Fang Yan,Simon Foster,Xiangyang Ji*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出Forge管道，通过形式化验证引导"氛围编码"（vibe coding）生成的安全关键Java代码，利用模型驱动工程从LLM生成代码中提取三种形式化模型（Dafny、CSP/FDR4、Z-Machines/Isabelle），将验证失败转化为结构化反馈迭代改进，从而生成符合DO-178C等安全标准的认证证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: "氛围编码"（直接接受LLM生成的代码）虽快但缺乏形式化正确性保证，无法满足DO-178C、IEC 61508、ISO 26262等安全关键系统的认证要求；现有方案依赖Dafny、Verus、Lean等验证感知语言，这些语言在预训练数据中稀缺且工业工具链中缺失。

Method: 提出Forge（面向形式化方法的生成代码精化循环）：一个闭环管道，通过氛围编码生成Java源代码，再通过模型变换提取三种形式化制品——演绎验证（Dafny）、CSP精化（FDR4检查器）、Z-Machines定理证明（Isabelle）；每次验证失败转化为结构化修正提示驱动下一轮代码生成迭代。LLM充当草稿生成器，MDE链充当判别器，开发者无需阅读形式化模型。

Result: 实验表明，该管道能够为LLM生成的Java代码生成符合安全标准要求的验证证据，向认证方向迈进一步。

Conclusion: Forge弥合了氛围编码与安全关键软件认证之间的鸿沟，通过MDE链作为形式化验证的判别器，在无需开发者掌握形式化方法的前提下生成可认证的验证证据。

Abstract: Vibe coding -- accepting LLM-generated source from natural-language intent with minimal review -- is fast and may be adequate for low-criticality consumer software. But for safety-critical systems governed by DO-178C, IEC 61508, or ISO 26262, it offers no path to certification: large language models (LLMs) provide no formal correctness guarantees, and existing remedies target verification-aware languages (Dafny, Verus, Lean) that are scarce in pretraining data and absent from industrial toolchains.
  This paper closes the gap. We present Forge (Formal method Oriented Refinement loop for GEnerated code): a closed-loop pipeline that guides vibe coding through formal verification using established Model-Driven Engineering (MDE) infrastructure. Through vibe coding, we generate Java source code; our pipeline then extracts -- via model transformations -- formal artefacts in three different formalisms, each checked by a complementary verifier: deductive verification (Dafny), Communicating Sequential Processes (CSP) refinement via the Failures-Divergences Refinement checker (FDR4), and theorem proving using Z-Machines in Isabelle; every verification failure becomes a structured correction prompt that drives the next code-generation iteration. The LLM is the draft generator, the MDE chain is the discriminator, and the developer never has to read the formal models.
  Empirically, we find that the pipeline produces standards-relevant verification evidence for LLM-generated Java -- a step toward certification.

</details>


### [464] [All Green, Still Broken: Real-Flow Verification Lessons from an LLM-Integrated, Multi-Market Web Application](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22475)
*Muhammad Bilal,Ali Hassaan Mughal*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 现代Web应用面临大语言模型输出、多市场国际化、浏览器前端与外部数据源结合带来的测试难题。本研究分析了生产环境中的租赁搜索助手项目，其自动化测试套件在六周内增长到1553个测试用例，但用户可见缺陷仍不断流入生产环境。通过对252个bug修复提交的分类分析，发现约44%的修复涉及组件级单元测试无法观测的四个接缝：实时浏览器运行环境、非默认市场、端到端流程和全系统级别。未在接缝处设置防护的修复导致同一缺陷两次上线。本文提出了四接缝框架、缺陷分布测量结果以及团队可采用的实践方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代Web应用融合了大语言模型输出、多市场国际化、浏览器驱动前端与外部数据源三种难以测试的要素，传统的组件级单元测试无法覆盖关键缺陷边界，导致用户可见缺陷持续流入生产环境，亟需系统性的测试框架来识别和弥补测试盲区。

Method: 对生产环境中的租赁搜索助手项目进行实证研究，收集了六周内自动化测试套件发展至1553个测试用例的数据，系统分析了252个bug修复提交，按缺陷逃逸的边界（接缝）进行分类，识别出组件级单元测试无法观测的四类接缝，并基于缺陷分布提出对应的测试实践框架。

Result: 约44%的bug修复属于四类接缝：实时浏览器运行环境、非默认市场、端到端流程和全系统级别。其中未在接缝处设置防护的修复导致同一缺陷两次上线。研究呈现了缺陷分布测量结果和团队可采用的接缝识别方法。

Conclusion: 当前自动化测试套件在覆盖关键缺陷边界方面存在系统性盲区，需在组件测试之外建立针对四类接缝的系统性防护机制。本文提出的四接缝框架和缺陷分布分析可为类似现代Web应用的测试策略优化提供指导。

Abstract: Modern web applications increasingly combine three ingredients that are hard to test: output from large language models, multi-market internationalization, and browser-driven front-ends over external data sources. We report on a production rental-search assistant whose automated suite grew to 1,553 test cases in six weeks. The suite passed continuously, yet user-facing defects continued to reach production. We studied all 252 bug-fix commits in the project and classified each by the boundary, or seam, it escaped through. About 44 percent of the fixes fall in four seams that component-level unit tests cannot observe: the live browser runtime, the non-default market, the end-to-end flow, and the whole-system level. A fix without a guard at the seam let one defect ship twice. We present the four-seam framework, the measured defect distribution, and the practices we adopted, including a simple way for a team to find the seam that carries the most fixes.

</details>


### [465] [WebCQ: Cooperative Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning for Scalable Web GUI Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22502)
*Yujia Fan,Sinan Wang,Zebang Fei,Yao Qin,Huaxuan Li,Yepang Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出WebCQ，一种基于QTRAN和多智能体强化学习的可扩展Web GUI测试方法，在8个大型商业网站上比现有方法MARG探索了33.3%更多状态、执行了42.2%更多独特动作，并触发了更多故障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于MARL的GUI测试方法（如MARG、Fastbot）受限于表格型强化学习算法，难以扩展到具有巨大状态空间和大量交互元素的大型商业Web应用。

Method: WebCQ采用QTRAN实现多智能体协调，引入轻量级同步机制支持异步Web测试；提取每个UI事件的语义和探索特征构成动作向量，与当前状态向量拼接后输入策略网络，基于DQN在动态动作空间中决策。

Result: 在8个大型商业网站上的实验表明：相同时间预算和智能体数量下，WebCQ比MARG多探索33.3%状态、执行42.2%更多独特动作；在6/8网站上触发更多故障；20小时实验中保持更高动作吞吐量，且随智能体数量增加性能提升更显著。

Conclusion: WebCQ克服了现有MARL方法的关键局限性，为现代Web GUI测试提供了可扩展且有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL)-based techniques have shown promise for GUI testing. However, as the complexity of modern GUI software increases, existing MARL-based approaches (e.g., MARG and Fastbot) struggle to scale due to the inherent limitations of their underlying tabular reinforcement learning algorithms. This limits their applicability to large-scale commercial GUI software, especially web applications with vast state spaces and many interactive elements. To fill this gap, we propose WebCQ, a novel MARL-based approach for scalable web GUI testing. WebCQ incorporates QTRAN for multi-agent coordination and a lightweight synchronization mechanism, allowing it to work under asynchronous web testing scenarios. It extracts semantic and exploration features for each UI event to form an action vector. This vector is concatenated with the current state vector and fed into the policy network, enabling DQN-based decision making within a dynamic action space. We evaluated WebCQ on eight large-scale commercial websites. Under the same time budget and agent count, WebCQ explored 33.3% more states and executed 42.2% more unique actions than MARG, while triggering more failures on six of the eight websites under test. It also demonstrated strong scalability, maintaining higher action throughput during 20-hour experiments, and achieving greater performance improvements as the number of agents increased. These results show that WebCQovercomes key limitations of existing MARL-based approaches, providing a scalable and effective solution for enhancing modern web GUI testing.

</details>


### [466] [What Characterizes Pairwise Modular Smells?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22576)
*Chenxing Zhong,Daniel Feitosa,Paris Avgeriou,Huang Huang,Wei Song,He Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的架构异味——Pairwise Modular Smell (PairSmell)，用于识别模块化设计中的缺陷决策。通过快速综述收集19种配对特征，并利用机器学习模型（基于11个Java项目的613.5万+实体对）预测两种PairSmell形式（InSep和InCol），模型ROC-AUC较基线提升最多58.6%。解释模型发现：InSep的关键特征为出向依赖、与其他实体共享的术语和声明的字段；InCol的关键特征为基于tf-idf的语义相似性、配对间共享术语、与其他实体共享的术语和入向依赖。最后通过实例说明这些特征如何影响PairSmell的产生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有软件模块化方法和设计问题识别方法在实际指导有效改进时往往不够实用。为弥补这一空白，作者在前期研究中引入了PairSmell这一新型架构异味，用于识别需要进一步检查的缺陷架构决策。

Method: (1) 通过快速综述收集并综合19种用于表示两个实体间关系的配对特征；(2) 基于11个开源Java项目构建包含6,135,000+实体对的数据集；(3) 使用收集的特征训练机器学习模型，预测两种PairSmell形式（InSep和InCol）；(4) 通过模型解释识别最具影响力的特征；(5) 通过实例说明特征如何影响PairSmell的产生。

Result: 训练的模型在ROC-AUC上较基线提升最多58.6%。InSep的最重要特征为出向依赖、与其他实体共享的术语和声明的字段；InCol的最重要特征为基于tf-idf的语义相似性、配对间共享术语、与其他实体共享的术语和入向依赖。

Conclusion: PairSmell能够有效识别模块化设计中的缺陷，且通过配对特征分析可以解释其成因，为实际重构提供指导。

Abstract: Enhancing the modular structure of existing systems has attracted substantial research interest, primarily through (1) software modularization and (2) identifying design issues (e.g., smells) as refactoring opportunities; however, both approaches often prove impractical to guide effective improvement. Inspired by both aforementioned approaches, our previous study introduced a novel and practical architectural smell -- called Pairwise Modular Smell (or PairSmell) -- for identifying flawed architectural decisions that necessitate further examination.
  The objective of this study is to explain PairSmell from the perspective of pair characteristics. To this end, we first conduct a rapid review to collect and synthesize 19 pair characteristics that have been used in the literature to represent relationships between two entities. The collected characteristics are then used to train machine learning models for predicting two forms of PairSmell -- inapt separated pairs InSep and inapt collocated pairs InCol, based on a curated dataset of over 6,135,000 pairs of entities derived from 11 open-source Java projects. The trained models achieve up to a 58.6% improvement in ROC-AUC over the baselines. The interpretation of the models reveals that the most influential features for InSep are out-going dependencies, terms shared with others, and declared fields; while those for InCol include semantic similarity based on tf-idf, terms shared between the pair, terms shared with others, and in-going dependencies. We complement the work with a series of practical examples to illustrate how the influential pair characteristics impact the occurrence of PairSmell.

</details>


### [467] [On Good Authority: Release-Authority Measurement for Registry-Mediated Package Ecosystems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22593)
*Igor Santos-Grueiro*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种 predecessor-aware release-authority record（前驱感知的发布权威记录），用于检测公开发布路径中的不连续性（public release-path discontinuities）。通过在 npm、PyPI、Maven Central、crates.io、RubyGems 五大生态的 45,812 个发布版本中应用透明规则，识别出 204 个触发策略告警的发布路径变更，并通过人工评审验证了其作为审查信号的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的依赖图只能展示代码的流动方向，但无法反映公开发布所使用的路径（如发布者、仓库、工作流、来源证明、签名、中介证据等）是否发生了变化。这种隐式的变化可能隐藏供应链攻击或发布流程篡改，因此需要一种显式的记录机制来捕捉发布权威路径的变更。

Method: 定义 predecessor-aware release-authority record，比较每个包版本与其直接前驱在发布者、仓库、工作流、来源证明、签名和中介证据六个维度上的差异。对 npm、PyPI、Maven Central、crates.io、RubyGems 五大生态进行抽样审计（2024年4月至2026年6月），共 45,812 个发布、43,100 个前驱比较、942 个包坐标。采用透明规则识别触发策略告警的发布路径不连续性，并设计统一语义距离规则和描述性特定生态规则进行筛选。通过三组实践者的盲审评估（60行共享核心，30个触发+30个对照）验证信号有效性。

Result: 透明规则识别出 204 个策略触发的公开发布路径不连续性。统一语义距离规则选出 320 个发布（覆盖 190/204 触发）；描述性特定生态规则选出 337 个发布（覆盖全部 204 个触发）。盲审中，30 个触发中 20 个被评为“立即审查”，9 个为“监控”，1 个为“无需审查”；30 个对照全部评为“无需审查”。外部对齐的已知恶意版本与策略触发零重叠。

Conclusion: 发布路径权威记录能够有效检测公开发布路径的变更，为人工审查提供有价值的信号。但该方法无法覆盖同路径下的篡改、未变更的受损 CI、以及公共快照中缺失的版本，这些需要额外的证据源来补充。

Abstract: Dependency graphs show where released code can flow, while leaving implicit whether the public path used to publish a release changed. We introduce a predecessor-aware release-authority record that compares each package release with its immediate predecessor across publisher, repository, workflow, provenance, signing, and mediation evidence.
  We instantiate the record over a purposefully sampled, audited April 2024--June 2026 cohort from npm, PyPI, Maven Central, crates.io, and RubyGems: 45,812 releases, 43,100 eligible predecessor comparisons, and 942 package coordinates. Go is reported separately as a VCS/proxy/checksum-log boundary adapter. Transparent rules identify 204 policy-triggering public release-path discontinuities. The exact trigger policy is the primary candidate queue. A uniform semantic-distance rule selects 320 releases and covers 190/204 triggers; a descriptive regime-specific rule selects 337 releases and covers all 204. In a blinded 60-row shared core, three practitioners rated 20/30 triggers as immediate review, 9/30 as monitoring, 1/30 as no review, and all 30 controls as no review.
  These signals are review cues over public release-path evidence. Exact malicious versions in our external alignment have zero overlap with the policy triggers. Same-path compromise, unchanged compromised CI, and versions absent from public snapshots require separate evidence beyond this release-path record.

</details>


### [468] [RigorBench: Benchmarking Engineering Process Discipline in Autonomous AI Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22678)
*Meher Bhaskar Madiraju,Meher Sai Preetam Madiraju*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出RigorBench——首个衡量AI编码智能体过程纪律的基准，通过五个维度（规划保真度、验证覆盖率、恢复效率、弃权质量、原子转换完整性）评估智能体，发现结构化过程纪律平均提升过程质量分数41%，并提高下游结果正确性17%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准仅关注编码智能体的结果正确性（是否通过测试或解决问题），忽视了过程纪律（规划、验证、优雅恢复等工程规范）的重要性。一个通过鲁莽试错获得正确答案的智能体本质上不如遵循严谨工程纪律的智能体可靠。

Method: 设计了RigorBench基准，包含五个评估支柱（规划保真度、验证覆盖率、恢复效率、弃权质量、原子转换完整性），通过加权求和得到复合RigorScore。构建了涵盖五种任务类别（Plan-Then-Build、Verify-Or-Die、Doom Loop Gauntlet、Know When to Fold、Don't Break the Build）的30个任务集，采用有/无对照实验设计评估领先的编码智能体框架。

Result: 结构化过程纪律平均提升过程质量分数41%，同时提高下游结果正确性17%。这是首个定量证据表明智能体如何编码与编码产出的结果同等重要。

Conclusion: 首次证明了编码智能体的过程纪律可量化评估，并且过程质量的提升能带来结果正确性的改善，为AI编码智能体的可靠性评估提供了新维度。

Abstract: Agentic coding harnesses - such as Agent-Skills, Superpowers, and Agent-Rigor - are increasingly deployed to augment underlying LLMs for real-world software engineering tasks. Existing benchmarks evaluate these agents almost exclusively on outcome correctness: whether generated code passes tests or resolves issues. We argue that this outcome-only lens is insufficient: an agent that arrives at a correct solution through reckless trial-and-error, without planning, verification, or graceful recovery, is fundamentally less reliable than one that follows sound engineering discipline. We introduce RigorBench, the first benchmark designed to measure process discipline in AI coding agents. RigorBench evaluates these harnesses across five pillars: Planning Fidelity, Verification Coverage, Recovery Efficiency, Abstention Quality, and Atomic Transition Integrity. A composite RigorScore aggregates these dimensions into a single metric via a weighted sum. We curate a suite of 30 tasks spanning five categories - Plan-Then-Build, Verify-Or-Die, Doom Loop Gauntlet, Know When to Fold, and Don't Break the Build-and evaluate leading harnesses in a controlled with/without experimental design against baseline coding assistants. Our results show that structured process discipline not only improves process quality scores by an average of 41% but also raises downstream outcome correctness by 17%, providing the first quantitative evidence that how agents code matters as much as what they produce. We release the full benchmark, scoring rubrics, and trajectory analysis tools as open-source artifacts.

</details>


### [469] [Identifying Quality Indicators in Student Self-Reflections in Software Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22683)
*Matthew Minish,Matthias Galster,Fabian Gilson*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套包含八个指标的反思性写作评估框架，并基于微调的RoBERTa模型构建了自动分类器，能够在软件工程教育中高效、准确地评估学生的反思文本，显著优于零样本大语言模型，为规模化、结构化的反思反馈提供了可行方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在软件工程项目式课程中，反思能力是学生的核心技能，但教师手动评估学生反思文本耗时且反馈笼统，难以提供针对性指导。现有研究缺乏专门针对软件工程领域的自动化反思评估工具。

Method: 通过迭代精炼现有反思框架，构建八指标评估体系；三位标注员标注学生反思文本并达成中等至可靠的信度；训练多种仅编码器Transformer模型（如RoBERTa），并与仅解码器大语言模型（零样本提示）进行对比。

Result: 微调后的RoBERTa模型在准确率和速度上均显著优于仅解码器模型，在多数指标上达到人类水平的分类表现，支持近即时分类；提供了两种针对不同评估优先级优化的模型变体。

Conclusion: 微调的仅编码器模型能够高效实现反思性写作的自动化评估，该框架和自动分类器为软件工程教育中提供及时、结构化的反思反馈提供了有效手段。

Abstract: Context: Reflection is a fundamental skill in software engineering education, particularly in project-based courses where students learn through extended group work and need to develop their ability to reflect iteratively throughout their work. For students to benefit from reflection, their written reflections need to be assessed so that feedback can guide and improve their reflective practice. However, manually assessing written reflections to guide reflections is time-consuming, and often results in broad, non-specific feedback for a student to improve. Objective: This study builds on reflective writing frameworks to produce an eight-indicator scheme for assessing student reflections in software engineering. Furthermore, this study validates an automated classifier for assessing reflections against the framework, enabling scalable and structured feedback whilst reducing instructor workload. Method: We adapted existing reflection frameworks through iterative refinement to create our eight-indicator framework. Three annotators labelled student reflection texts, establishing moderate to reliable inter-rater agreement. We then trained and evaluated multiple encoder-only transformer models and compared them with decoder-only large language models using zero-shot prompting. Results: The fine-tuned RoBERTa model achieved the strongest performance, substantially outperforming decoder-only models in both accuracy and speed. The classifier demonstrated human-level agreement on most indicators whilst enabling near-instantaneous classification. We provide two model variants optimised for different assessment priorities. Conclusions: Our fine-tuned encoder-only models enable efficient automated assessment of reflective writing. The framework and automated classifier offer a means to provide timely, structured feedback on student reflections in software engineering.

</details>


### [470] [Beyond Simpson's Paradox: A Cascade of Confounders in AI Agent Pull-Request Co-Authorship](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22711)
*Haoran Yu,Xiaochong Jiang,Lifei Liu,Su Wang,Pin Qian,Yihang Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 通过对33,596个PR的分析，发现AI编码代理中人类共同作者标签看似降低合并率（53.8% vs 79.8%）的现象实际上是辛普森悖论：按代理分层后方向逆转。但进一步控制仓库和PR结构后，所有代理的共同作者效应消失，表明该关联是选择偏差和PR结构假象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示AI编码代理中人类共同作者与PR合并率之间关系的真实因果效应，纠正因聚合统计和混杂因素导致的误导性结论。

Method: 基于AIDev数据集的33,596个PR，采用分层分析（按代理身份）、仓库内对照、提交次数控制等多层统计方法，逐步剥离辛普森悖论和混杂因素。

Result: 聚合数据显示共同作者PR合并率更低（53.8% vs 79.8%），但辛普森悖论存在：Copilot和Devin的正效应分别+41.2和+33.5 pp，而其他代理效应不显著。控制仓库后Devin效应消失（+1.6 pp, p=0.73），控制提交次数后Copilot效应减半（+24.4 pp），限制多提交PR后Copilot效应消失（+4.8 pp, p=0.59）。

Conclusion: 不应报告未经分层的代理聚合统计；跨截面共同作者关联主要是选择和PR结构假象，而非因果性益处。

Abstract: Pooled across five AI coding agents, pull requests (PRs) with a human Co-Authored-By trailer merge less often than purely-autonomous ones (53.8% vs. 79.8%) -- yet this aggregate finding is a textbook Simpson's Paradox. Stratifying 33,596 PRs from the AIDev dataset by agent identity reverses the conclusion: Copilot and Devin show large positive within-agent gaps (+41.2 and +33.5 pp, both p<0.001), while Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex show small effects whose cross-sectional 95% CIs span zero. The paradox is driven entirely by agent composition: Codex, which dominates 64.9% of the dataset, achieves high merge rates while rarely using co-authorship. But Simpson's Paradox is only the first layer of a cascade of confounders: within-repo controls eliminate Devin's gap (+33.5 to +1.6 pp, p=0.73); a commit-count control further halves Copilot's within-repo gap (+36.2 to +24.4 pp); restricted to multi-commit PRs, the Copilot within-repo effect dissolves to +4.8 pp (p=0.59). No agent retains a clear co-authorship effect once both repository selection and PR structure are controlled. Our findings caution against reporting agent-pooled statistics without stratification and demonstrate that cross-sectional co-authorship associations are largely selection and PR-structure artefacts rather than evidence of a causal benefit.

</details>


### [471] [Habituation at the Gate: Rising Approval and Declining Scrutiny in Human Review of AI Agent Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22721)
*Haoran Yu,Lifei Liu,Xiaochong Jiang,Yuwen Jia,Su Wang,Pin Qian,Yihang Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 通过对400名重复审稿人的纵向分析，发现AI代码审稿的批准率从30.1%上升到36.8%（p<10^{-6}），但审查延迟增加3.5倍，内联评论量减少22%，表明审稿人因工作量增加而产生习惯性反应，而非理性信任校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究当AI编码代理大规模提交PR时，人类审稿人是否会随着时间推移逐渐降低对AI生成代码的审查标准。

Method: 使用AIDev数据集进行纵向审稿人内分析，研究400名重复审稿人的11,429条审查记录，比较早期与晚期审查表现，并进行经验驱动、代理特异性、PR难度等多维度控制分析。

Result: 批准率从30.1%升至36.8%；经验驱动效应显著；审查延迟增加3.5倍；内联评论量减少22%；人类PR批准率同期下降。

Conclusion: 审稿人的行为变化更符合工作负载增加下的反射性习惯化，而非理性信任校准。

Abstract: As AI coding agents (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Devin, OpenAI Codex, Cursor) submit pull requests to open-source repositories at scale, a key question arises: do human reviewers gradually lower their scrutiny for AI-generated code over time? We conduct a longitudinal within-reviewer analysis using the AIDev dataset, studying 400 repeat reviewers who collectively submitted 11,429 reviews over a seven-month observation period. Comparing each reviewer's early and late review episodes, we observe a population-level shift in approval rate from 30.1% to 36.8% (Wilcoxon signed-rank p < 10^{-6} on paired shifts). Pooled by within-reviewer experience decile, the cumulative gap reaches +14.5 pp from first to tenth decile. This shift is experience-driven (persists after controlling for calendar time), agent-specific (human PR approval rates decline over the same period), and not explained by PR difficulty (median PR size is flat). However, review latency increases rather than decreases (+3.5x), while inline comment volume decreases (-22%, p=0.0014), suggesting reviewers spend more time in queue but less time actively inspecting code. The combination of rising approval, declining comment effort, and increasing queue time is most consistent with reflexive habituation under growing workload rather than rational trust calibration alone.

</details>


### [472] [Integrating Heterogeneous Digital Twins in Federated Ecosystems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22791)
*Christian Vergara-Marcillo,Rami Bahsoon,Nikos Tziritas,Wendy Yanez-Pazmino,Panagiotis Oikonomou,Georgios Theodoropoulos*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为Federation Node Manager的模块化集成机制，用于连接异构数字孪生体至联邦生态系统，支持协议/模式适配、能力暴露和状态事件协调，并在智能交通应急场景中验证了可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数字孪生体在单机场景下有效，但生态系统级部署需要多个自主、分布式DT跨系统边界协作，而现有的联邦数字孪生生态系统研究仍停留在概念阶段，缺乏异构DT的实用集成方案。

Method: 提出Federation Node Manager模块化集成机制，通过可控能力暴露、协议与模式适配、以及及时的状态与事件交换，将本地DT连接到联邦环境，并基于服务导向架构设计。

Result: 完成了概念设计与原型实现，并在智能交通领域的应急响应场景中验证了所提机制的可行性。

Conclusion: 所提出的机制可作为更广泛的服务导向联邦DT生态系统中的使能组件，解决了异构DT在联邦环境下的实际集成与运行时协调问题。

Abstract: Digital Twins (DTs) are increasingly used to virtualise physical systems at different scales, enabling monitoring, simulation, and predictions to support decision-making. However, while individual DTs are effective in stand-alone settings, ecosystem-scale deployments require multiple autonomous and distributed DTs to cooperate across system boundaries despite differences in modelling approaches or software technologies, making interoperability and runtime coordination critical challenges. Although \textit{Federated Digital Twin Ecosystems} have emerged as a promising direction, existing research remains at the conceptual stage, offering high-level architectures while leaving the practical integration of heterogeneous DTs underexplored. This paper proposes the \textit{Federation Node Manager}, a modular integration mechanism that connects local DTs to a federated environment through controlled capability exposure, protocol and schema adaptation, and timely state and event exchange for coordinated operations. We present a conceptual design and a prototype implementation, and demonstrate their feasibility in the smart mobility domain for emergency response scenarios. The proposed mechanism serves as an enabling component within a broader service-oriented federated DT ecosystem.

</details>


### [473] [From Fragments to Paths: Task-Level Context Recovery for Large Industrial Codebases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22906)
*Jiawei He,Weisong Sun,Mengyu Shi,Jie Jia,Tong Bian,Xikai Yang,Dong Sun*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: DeepDiscovery 是一种面向大型工业代码仓库的任务级理解方法，采用两阶段"定位-推理"框架，在预算约束下利用多关系仓库结构恢复任务相关上下文。在方法级评估、内部工业任务及SWE-bench Verified端到端评估中，DeepDiscovery 均显著提升了文件召回质量和下游软件工程性能，SWE-bench Verified上达到78.6%的解决率，较基线提升8.2个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在软件工程任务上表现强劲，但理解大型工业代码仓库仍具挑战。现有方法通常仅检索局部片段，无法恢复复杂仓库级任务所需的更广泛上下文。

Method: 提出两阶段"定位-推理"(Location-Inference)框架：首先定位高置信度的任务锚点(anchors)，然后在多关系仓库结构上、在预算约束下恢复更广泛的任务相关上下文。

Result: 在27个中等规模任务上，无离线预处理即达到最佳文件恢复质量；内部工业任务中，全召回率绝对提升1.6-9.2个百分点（大规模子项目）和2.5-7.4个百分点（中等规模子项目）；SWE-bench Verified上解决率达78.6%，较基线提升8.2个百分点。

Conclusion: 更强的任务级仓库理解能够提升编码智能体在复杂软件工程任务上的性能表现。

Abstract: Large language models have shown strong performance on software engineering (SE) tasks, yet understanding large industrial repositories remains challenging. Existing methods often retrieve only local fragments and fail to recover the broader task-relevant context needed for complex repository-level tasks. We present DeepDiscovery, a task-level repository-understanding method for large industrial codebases. DeepDiscovery uses a two-stage \textit{Location--Inference} framework to localize high-confidence task anchors and recover broader task-relevant context over multi-relational repository structure under budget constraints. Across controlled method-level evaluation, organization-internal industrial repository-understanding scenarios, and end-to-end evaluation on SWE-bench Verified, DeepDiscovery consistently improves task-relevant file recovery and downstream SE performance. On 27 medium-scale tasks, DeepDiscovery achieves the best file recovery quality among five representative baselines without offline preprocessing. On organization-internal industrial tasks from a production-scale integrated codebase ecosystem, including 27 medium-scale tasks and 40 large-scale tasks, DeepDiscovery improves Full Recall Rate across multiple AI coding systems, with absolute gains ranging from 1.6 to 9.2 percentage points on large subprojects and from 2.5 to 7.4 percentage points on medium-scale subprojects. In a controlled end-to-end evaluation on SWE-bench Verified, a system equipped with DeepDiscovery achieves a 78.6\% Solve Rate, outperforming the corresponding baseline by 8.2 percentage points. These results suggest that stronger task-level repository understanding can improve coding-agent performance on complex SE tasks.

</details>


### [474] [EnerInfer: Energy-Aware On-Device LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23001)
*Bohua Zou,Nian Liu,Binqi Sun,Matteo Mascherin,Debayan Roy,Yutao Liu,Yu Peng,Ning Jia,Haibo Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出EnerInfer，首个面向端侧LLM推理的能效与热管理框架，通过利用配置松弛（适度降低NPU/内存频率）在保障服务质量的前提下显著提升能效并降低发热，采用模型结构感知的预测与排名驱动在线反馈机制，在真实设备上实现最高65%的能效提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端侧LLM推理的能耗和热成本是关键瓶颈，现有系统仅优化解码速度（默认更快更好），但实际存在可挖掘的配置松弛空间——适度降频可在不影响用户体验的前提下大幅提升能效并减少发热。

Method: EnerInfer框架包含三大核心：1）去聚合并模型结构感知的吞吐/功耗预测（无需逐模型预配置）；2）排名驱动的在线反馈机制，在运行时干扰下选择满足QoE的高效NPU/DDR频率配置；3）轻量级有限视野热预测，动态切换能效优化模式与热约束模式。

Result: 在手机、笔记本和开发板上分别实现最高65%、12%和24%的能效提升，且未违反QoE约束。

Conclusion: 通过引入配置松弛的概念和去聚合预测方法，EnerInfer有效解决了端侧LLM推理的能耗与热管理难题，验证了降频增效率的可行性。

Abstract: On-device LLM inference is increasingly attractive for privacy-preserving, reliable, and cost-effective deployment, yet its energy and thermal costs remain a critical bottleneck. Existing systems primarily optimize for decoding speed, implicitly assuming that faster execution is always preferable. We show instead that on-device LLM inference often has exploitable configuration slack: modestly lowering NPU and memory frequencies preserves quality of experience (QoE) while substantially improving energy efficiency and reducing heat.
  Realizing this opportunity in production is challenging. The most energy-efficient NPU/DDR setting varies with the model, inference engine, platform, and runtime conditions, with no stable ranking across configurations. Commercial devices further lack component-level power sensing, and shell temperature evolves with request arrivals, response lengths, and thermal history. To address these challenges, we propose EnerInfer, the first on-device LLM inference framework that jointly manages energy efficiency, throughput, and thermal comfort for LLM workloads. EnerInfer replaces per-model profiling and sensor-heavy control with disaggregated, model-structure-aware prediction and ranking-driven online feedback. It predicts throughput and power for unseen LLMs across NPU/DDR frequency settings, selects QoE-satisfying efficient configurations under runtime interference, and uses lightweight limited-horizon thermal prediction to dynamically switch between energy-optimized and thermally constrained inference. Evaluations on real-world LLMs show that EnerInfer improves energy efficiency by up to 65%, 12%, and 24% on phones, a laptop, and a development board, respectively, without QoE violation.

</details>


### [475] [The EVerest Dataset for Secure Software Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23197)
*Sophie Corallo,Debora Grupp,Dominik Fuchß,Jan Keim,Frederik Reiche,Tobias Hey,Anne Koziolek*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了EVerest数据集，这是一个基于电动汽车充电站开源软件栈的多工件资源，包含人工标注的安全需求、细粒度安全要素、架构模型、源代码和文档，填补了现有数据集缺乏端到端安全验证支持的空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据集无法同时覆盖需求、架构和代码三种工件类型并提供细粒度安全标签，阻碍了端到端安全验证的研究。

Method: 基于EVerest开源项目，人工构建了包含84条安全需求（标注安全目标）、1,445个细粒度安全要素（组件、实体、数据、数据流、状态等）、验收窗口、共指关系及架构追踪链接的数据集，同时包含软件架构模型、源代码和自然语言文档。

Result: 在数据集创建过程中发现并披露了一个真实的安全弱点（CWE-1295），已被项目维护者修复。数据集已公开可用。

Conclusion: 该数据集支持安全需求分类、命名实体识别、架构追踪链接以及设计/代码级安全验证等多类研究，为端到端安全验证提供了稀缺的多工件资源。

Abstract: End-to-end security verification, from requirements through architecture to code, requires datasets that span all three artifact types with fine-grained security labels. No existing dataset provides this combination. We present the EVerest dataset, a multi-artifact resource based on EVerest, an industry-driven open-source software stack for electric vehicle charging stations. The dataset includes 84 manually elicited security requirements annotated with security objectives, 1,445 fine-grained security elements (components, entities, data, data flows, states, etc.), acceptance windows, coreferences, and architectural trace links, as well as the EVerest software architecture model, source code, and natural language documentation. It enables research on security requirements classification, named entity recognition, architectural trace linking, and design-time or code-level security verification. During dataset creation, a real security weakness (CWE-1295) was identified, disclosed to the project maintainers, and subsequently fixed. The dataset is publicly available. A short video is available at https://youtu.be/pnn1uqpomvQ.

</details>


### [476] [Generate with CodeXHug: A Dataset to Enhance Model Cards with Code Usage Patterns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23329)
*Stefano Palombo,Claudio Di Sipio,Juri Di Rocco,Davide Di Ruscio*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出CodeXHug数据集，收集了HuggingFace上7325个PTM在GitHub中的实际使用代码（20545个Python文件），并通过统计分析和聚类技术提取代表性代码使用模式，以帮助开发者更好地在实际项目中采用预训练模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练模型（PTMs）在软件工程中越来越流行，但实际项目中的采用情况尚不明确（许多仅在玩具项目中使用或仅作为HF仓库镜像）；同时，现有的模型卡片和文档缺乏解释性代码模式，增加了新手使用难度，因此需要一个关于PTMs的精选代码库来支持开发者。

Method: 首先从最新的HuggingFace数据转储中筛选带有标签和模型卡片的PTM；然后查询GitHub平台找到这些PTM的实际使用案例，最终得到7325个模型和20545个Python文件；之后通过统计分析和聚类技术从相关代码片段中提取代表性代码使用模式。

Result: 构建了CodeXHug数据集，包含7325个HuggingFace PTM及其在GitHub生态系统中的实际使用代码（20545个Python文件），并展示了通过聚类分析提取代表性代码使用模式的具体应用场景。

Conclusion: CodeXHug数据集能够为开发者提供预训练模型在实际项目中的代码使用模式参考，降低新手使用门槛，促进PTM在真实项目中的落地应用。

Abstract: Pre-trained models (PTMs) are becoming increasingly popular in the software engineering community. Their usage is facilitated by model repositories, e.g., HuggingFace, which collect, store, and maintain a wide range of PTMs. However, the actual adoption of these models in real-world projects is still an open question, i.e., many of them are used in toy projects or simply as a mirror for the HF repository. In addition, most of the available model cards and textual documents that contain critical information about their usage do not include explanatory code patterns, thus increasing the difficulty for newcomers. Thus, we see the need for a curated codebase related to PTMs to support developers and practitioners who are interested in using them in their projects.
  In this paper, we present CodeXHug, a curated dataset of HuggingFace PTMs exploited in the Github ecosystem and the related code usage patterns. Starting from the latest HF dump, we first conduct a data curation to collect PTMs with a tag and a model card. Then, the Github platform has been queried to find actual usages of the identified PTMs, resulting in 7,325 different models and 20,545 Python files.
